scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
Good day.
Rekenber is recruiting adventurers for an excavation project that takes place in Phantasmagorika, the newly discovered ruins in Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
您好。
雷根贝勒正在招募冒险者，参与优配擂斯新发现遗迹“幻象嘉年华”的发掘项目。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
If you're interested, just come as you are.
Everything you need for the excavation will be provided by Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
有兴趣的话，直接报名即可。
发掘所需的一切物资都由雷根贝勒提供。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
Join us for adventure at the newly discovered ruins in Juperos,
an ancient city whose scientific knowledge has fueled the development of modern civilization.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
加入我们，一同探索朱佩罗斯新发现的遗迹吧！
这座古城的科学知识曾推动现代文明发展。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
If you'd like to join, then form an excavation team and fill out your application.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
想加入的话，请组建一支发掘队并提交申请。

scripts.text: Excavation team? Application?
scripts.translation: 发掘队？申请？

scripts.text: Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation: 幻象嘉年华？

scripts.text: Bye.
scripts.translation: 再见。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
We're recruiting teams of excavators for the research of Phantasmagorika, the newly discovered ruins.
This project requires expertise in various fields, so we've decided to recruit
teams of excavators instead of individuals.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
我们正在为研究新发现的幻象嘉年华遗迹招募发掘队。
项目需要多个领域的专长，所以我们决定招募团队，而非个人。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
You can register for the excavation project,
and help us however you can.
Registered excavators receive special benefits and commodities
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
你可以登记参加发掘项目，
尽力协助我们。
登记的发掘人员可获得特别福利和物资，

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
in exchange for information that they discover in the ruins. We'll use the information to research the ruins.
Even if you fail to find useful information, we'll reward you just for your participation.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
作为交换，请提供你在遗迹中发现的情报，我们会用来研究遗迹。
即使没有发现有用信息，只要参与，我们也会给予奖励。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
If you want to join the project, please go submit your application to the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
想加入项目的话，请到乐园团提交申请。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
An ancient site was just discovered in Juperos.
It was hidden at the end of a long tunnel.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
朱佩罗斯刚发现一处古代遗址，
它藏在一条长隧道的尽头。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
Rekenber has named the site ^4d4dffPhantasmagorika^000000
and commenced an excavation.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
雷根贝勒将遗址命名为^4d4dff幻象嘉年华^000000，
并已开始发掘。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
We're hoping to find more advanced mado gears and a higher level of scientific knowledge than what was ever discovered in the Juperos region.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
我们希望能找到比朱佩罗斯地区以往发现的更先进魔导机甲，以及更高深的科学知识。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
Rekenber is looking for talented adventurers for the excavation of Phantasmagorika.
Feel free to join us anytime!
We need you!
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
雷根贝勒正在招募优秀冒险者，参与幻象嘉年华的发掘。
欢迎随时加入！
我们需要你！

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Welcome back,
{0}. I don't know how we can survive without you.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
欢迎回来，
{0}。没有你，我们真不知道该怎么办。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Have you heard?
An ancient site was just discovered in Juperos.
Rekenber is recruiting adventurers for the excavation of the place,
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
听说了吗？
朱佩罗斯刚发现一处古代遗址。
雷根贝勒正在招募冒险者参与发掘，

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
and we've decided to join it.
The Captain wants to see you about that.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
我们决定加入。
船长想和你谈谈这件事。

scripts.text: I didn't know you had a captain.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你们还有船长。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
What, did you think I was running this gig alone?
The Mistre--I mean, the Captain is rarely excited about anything, and this is one of those rare occasions. You should meet her.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
怎么，你以为这摊事只有我一个人在管？
舰长...我是说，船长平时很少这么兴奋。这可是难得一见，你该去见见她。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Her office is to the far left on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
她的办公室在二楼最左边。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
You need to Join the Eden Group first.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
你得先加入乐园团。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
I also come up here sometimes to attend some business.
Actually the central room is mine.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
我有时也会上来处理公务。
其实中间那间房是我的办公室。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Welcome back,
{0}. I don't know how we can survive without you.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
欢迎回来，
{0}。没有你，我们真不知道该怎么办。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
The Captain is waiting for you.
Her office is to the far left from here.
I'll see you again later.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
船长正在等你。
她的办公室就在左手边。
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
It seems everything went smoothly with the Captain.
Let's move to the central room, shall we?
We have a guest waiting
to talk us about something.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
看来你和船长谈得很顺利。
我们去中间的房间吧？
有位客人正在等着
和我们谈些事情。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
I'll be here rooting for you.
Don't worry about support.
I'll see that you get everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
我会在这里支持你的。
后勤不用担心，
我会确保你拿到所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
The excavation seems to be going well so far.
The item Dr. Atnad was interested in is also on Rekenber's radar; it should be appraised highly.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
目前发掘工作进展顺利。
阿特纳德博士看中的那件物品也引起了雷根贝勒的注意，应该能卖个好价钱。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Have you heard?
An ancient site was just discovered in Juperos.
Rekenber is recruiting adventurers for the excavation of the place,
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
听说了吗？
朱佩罗斯刚发现一处古代遗址。
雷根贝勒正在招募冒险者参与发掘，

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
and we've decided to join it.
The Captain wants to see you about that.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
我们决定加入。
船长想和你谈谈这件事。

scripts.text: I didn't know you had a captain.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你们还有船长。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
What, did you think I was running this gig alone?
The Mistre--I mean, the Captain is rarely excited about anything, and this is one of those rare occasions. You should meet her.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
怎么，你以为这摊事只有我一个人在管？
舰长...我是说，船长平时很少这么兴奋。这可是难得一见，你该去见见她。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Her office is to the far left on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
她的办公室在二楼最左边。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Thank you for helping the doctors focus on their work.
Keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[秘书莱姆·艾弗诺]
谢谢你帮医生们专心工作。
继续加油。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Lime]
{0}. Please come this way.
Let me introduce you to
Archaeologist Aures of the Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
{0}，请这边走。
让我为你介绍一下
阿特纳德发掘队的考古学家奥雷斯。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
This room is for employees only.
If you need a place to rest, please use the next room.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
这里是员工专用区。
需要休息的话，请去隔壁房间。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
The Captain is in the next room.
It's to the left.
Please talk to the Captain first.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
船长在隔壁房间，
就在左边。
请先去和船长谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
The excavation site is connected to Juperos,
so you should move to Juperos first.
The excavation project has been promoted widely, so you won't have a problem finding the representative.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
发掘地点与朱佩罗斯相连，
所以你得先去朱诺。
发掘项目已经广为宣传，到了那里很容易找到负责人。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
How's the situation at the excavation site?
Sigh, why can't Ian just forgive his daughter?
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
发掘现场情况怎么样？
唉，伊恩为什么就不能原谅女儿呢？

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Dr. Aures, this is {0}, who will assist you in Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
奥雷斯博士，这位是{0}，之后会在幻象嘉年华协助你。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Nice to meet you. My name is Aures.
Every member of my team is old and feeble. We really can use some young blood like you.
Welcome to the team.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
幸会，我叫奥雷斯。
队员们都上了年纪，体力也不如从前。正需要你这样年轻的新血加入。
欢迎入队。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
It seems everything went smoothly with the Captain.
Your job is simple:
just help Dr. Aures and his Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
看来你和船长谈得很顺利。
你的工作很简单：
协助奥雷斯博士和阿特纳德发掘队就行。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
I expect you'll spend most of your time running errands
and doing things that require physical stamina since all the members of the team are past their prime.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
队员们都过了壮年，
我想你大部分时间得跑腿，或是做些需要体力的工作。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
That's right. All of us retired a long time ago.
This excavation will probably be the last excavation we do before we die.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
没错，我们早就退休了。
这次发掘大概是我们有生之年最后一次了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
If Lime didn't help us, we would have changed our minds at the entrance to that place.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
要不是莱姆帮忙，我们恐怕刚到遗址入口就打退堂鼓了。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Please don't say that.
You're the most experienced archaeologists I've met.
By the way, how's Dr. Atnad?
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
别这么说。
你们是我见过经验最丰富的考古学家。
对了，阿特纳德博士怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Atnad? Don't get me started.
He's as stubborn as his daughter, if not more.
She liquidated her inheritance and left when she couldn't hear from her father.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
阿特纳德？别提了。
他和女儿一样固执，甚至有过之而无不及。
女儿一直收不到父亲的消息，最后变卖了继承的财产离开了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
He didn't keep touch with his family for years. When he found out his house was sold,
he lashed out and went off the grid,
and he's still angry at her.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
他好几年都没和家人联系。得知房子被卖掉后，他大发雷霆，从此销声匿迹，至今还在生女儿的气。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
And we're stuck in the middle of their mind game.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
结果我们夹在他们父女之间，左右为难。

scripts.text: Who are they?
scripts.translation: 他们是谁？

scripts.text: Cut to the chase, please.
scripts.translation: 请说重点。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Let me tell you. When Lime came to us,
we all wondered why a famous company like Eden Group would support a ragtag bunch of old men like us.
Then we found out they're father and daughter.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我来解释吧。莱姆来找我们时，我们都纳闷：乐园团这么有名的大公司，为什么要支持我们这群老家伙？
后来才知道，原来她和队长是父女。

scripts.text: Father and daughter? Who?
scripts.translation: 父女？谁和谁？

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Oh, didn't the Captain tell you?
Her father is the leader of the Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
哦，船长没告诉你吗？
她父亲就是阿特纳德发掘队的队长。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
When I first suggested we should join the project,
she wanted to support the Atnad Excavation Team.
At first I was thinking more along the lines of merging the team.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
我最初提议参加这个项目时，
船长就想支持阿特纳德发掘队。
我原本还想过把两支队伍合并。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Rekenber takes care of the financial aspects of the project, while we handle the manpower.
Then I realized the leader of the team is the father of my boss's.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
雷根贝勒负责项目经费，我们负责派人。
后来我才知道，队长竟然是我老板的父亲。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
I want to support the team to the best of my ability,
but their rocky relationship is getting in the way.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
我想尽全力支持这支队伍，
可他们父女关系紧张，事情因此变得棘手。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ian, I mean the old Atnad, welcomed your proposal with open arms.
Then he hit the roof when he realized your captain was his daughter.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
伊恩，我是说老阿特纳德，一开始非常欢迎莱姆的提议。得知你们船长就是他女儿后，他却勃然大怒。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I don't understand the hangup.
I mean she's his daughter, for the goodness's sake.
I think you should mediate between the two.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我真不懂他有什么好纠结的。那可是他的女儿啊！
我觉得你该帮他们调解一下。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
I hope this collaboration will be a chance for them to reconcile with each other.
Well, we should move to the site now.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
希望这次合作能成为他们和解的契机。
好了，我们该去发掘现场了。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Indeed. Before we go, let's talk about what we can expect at the site.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
没错。出发之前，先说说现场的情况吧。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Aures, Luke will come with you.
{0}, you can go to Phantasmagorika whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
奥雷斯，卢克会陪你一起去。
{0}，准备好后随时可以前往幻象嘉年华。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
It's accessible through Juperos,
so move to Juno first, then get to the entrance to Juperos from there.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
那里要经由朱佩罗斯前往。
先去朱诺，再从那里前往朱佩罗斯入口。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Rekenber has been promoting this project across the continent,
and has succeeded in bringing in more people than you can imagine.
Just look for a big crowd, and you won't miss the place. See you when you get there.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
雷根贝勒在整个大陆宣传这个项目，吸引到的人比你想象的还多。
找人最多的地方就行，绝不会错过。到现场见。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Everything should be easy enough for you,
though you'll have to register with Rekenber for the excavation.
You can register as an individual excavator, but I'd prefer if you do it as a member of the Atnad Excavation Team instead.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
这些事对你来说应该不难，
不过参加发掘前得先向雷根贝勒登记。
你可以登记为个人发掘者，但我更希望你加入阿特纳德发掘队，以队员身份登记。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Once your registration goes through, you can start working for the Atnad Excavation Team,
and everything else will take care of itself.
Thank you for doing this.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
登记通过后，你就能开始为阿特纳德发掘队工作，其他事情也会顺利安排好。
谢谢你愿意帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
I'm sorry, but he's our guest.
And this office is for Eden Group employees only.
The dormitory is the next room.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆]
抱歉，他是我们的客人。
而且这间办公室只对乐园团员工开放。
宿舍在隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I'll see you again at the excavation site, yeah?
The Eden Group has hired an escort for me, so I'll be traveling with him.
See you at the site.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
那我们发掘现场见吧？
乐园团给我安排了护卫，我会和他同行。
现场见。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Oh, you came.
I came here often.
I feel sorry for Luke, for he has to travel so often because of me.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
哦，你来了。我以前常来这里。
总让卢克为了我来回奔波，真过意不去。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It's great to have a place where I can come anytime I want. It's been years since I had a place I could call home.
Hah hah hah!
I'll see you at the excavation site.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
能有个随时想来就来的地方真好。我已经很多年没有自己的家了。
哈哈哈！
发掘现场见。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Hey, Lime.
We have a guest.
...
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
嘿，莱姆。
有客人来了。
...

scripts.text:
[Luke]
...
I've got nothing to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
...
我没什么话跟你说。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Hmm...
- You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Wait. Which excavation team are you from?
...You're independent.
Did you register independently? Do you have a referral?
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
等等，你属于哪支发掘队？
...你是独立发掘者。
你是个人登记的吗？有推荐信吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Wait.
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika excavation project?
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
等等。
你是幻象嘉年华发掘项目的参与者吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Just clear the tunnel of monsters,
and report to the Central Command Center.
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
清理隧道里的魔物，
然后向中央指挥中心报告。
谢谢帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
[Manager Michelle]
Are you looking for a new job?
If you prefer physical labor,
you can always exterminate monsters for me.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
想找份新工作吗？
喜欢体力活的话，
随时可以帮我消灭魔物。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Can you help me again?
You know, exterminate monsters in the tunnel and around this area.
This time, you can just report back to me instead of making a trip to the Central Command Center.
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
能再帮我一次吗？
去清理隧道和附近的魔物就行。
这次不用跑中央指挥中心，直接回来向我报告。
谢谢帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Just get rid of some in the tunnel and around here.
I'm glad you like the job.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
清理一下隧道和附近的魔物就好。
很高兴你喜欢这份工作。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Oh, good job wiping out monsters.
Our soldiers will be grateful for your help.
Please take this small token of appreciation.
I hope it'll be useful for you.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
干得好，魔物都清理掉了。
我们的士兵会感谢你的帮助。
请收下这份小小的谢礼，
希望对你有用。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Thank you for clearing the tunnel of monsters.
I'll appreciate it if you can keep doing it.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
谢谢你清理隧道里的魔物。
要是能继续帮忙，我会很感激。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Are you looking for a new job?
If you prefer physical labor,
you can always exterminate monsters for me.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
想找份新工作吗？
喜欢体力活的话，
随时可以帮我消灭魔物。

scripts.text: [Manager Michelle]
scripts.translation: [管理员米歇尔]

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
I didn't think so.
I'm sorry, but you have to have a referral or belong to an excavation team.
All sorts of people came looking for a job at the excavation site.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
我想也是。
很抱歉，你得有推荐信或加入一支发掘队才行。
最近什么人都跑来发掘现场找工作。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Oh, yes. The ^4d4dffEden Group^000000 is the easiest place to get a referral.
If you're qualified, then the Group will recommend you to us for the excavation project.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
对了，最容易拿到推荐信的地方就是^4d4dff乐园团^000000。
只要符合条件，他们就会推荐你参加发掘项目。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Now, please step back for your safety.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
为了安全起见，请往后退。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Let me check the roster.
Your name is... {0}. Ah, there you are.
You're from the Eden Group, all right.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
我查一下名单。
你的名字是...{0}。啊，找到了。
没错，你是乐园团的人。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
The excavation site is at the other end of this tunnel.
Once you're in, you're required to formally register yourself at the Central Command Center.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
发掘现场在这条隧道的另一端。
进去后，必须先到中央指挥中心正式登记。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Oh, and do me a favor.
Monsters from Juperos Ruins have migrated into the tunnel,
and they're getting out of hand.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
对了，还得麻烦你一件事。
朱佩罗斯遗迹里的魔物跑进了隧道，
现在已经难以控制。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Could you help us take care of them? Including the ones around here.
I'll write a letter of recommendation for you, so you can claim your rewards at the Central Command Center.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
能帮我们处理掉它们吗？附近的也要清理。
我会给你写推荐信，方便你去中央指挥中心领取奖励。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
When you're done, you can report back to me,
or go to Louis at the Central Command Center.
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[管理员米歇尔]
完成后可以回来向我报告，
也可以去中央指挥中心找路易斯。
谢谢帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Hello.
Thank you for using the Phantasmagorika excavation reception desk.
Do you have a referral? Or are you a member of an excavation team?
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
您好。
欢迎来到幻象嘉年华发掘接待处。
您有推荐信吗？或者是发掘队成员吗？

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Now you have unlimited access to this area.
Feel free to let us know if you experience problems excavating or exploring.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
现在你可以随时进入这个区域了。
发掘或探索过程中遇到问题，欢迎随时告诉我们。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
How are you today?
Keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
今天怎么样？
继续加油。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Oh, neither.
I'm sorry, but I can't let you register.
We do need excavators, but we have standards.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
哦，都不是啊。
抱歉，我不能为你登记。
我们确实需要发掘人员，但也有要求。

scripts.text: I want to register now.
scripts.translation: 我现在要登记。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Either you have a referral, or you have to be a member of an excavation team.
I'm sorry.
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
你必须有推荐信，或者加入一支发掘队。
很抱歉。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Nara]
If you don't know a place to get a referral or an excavation team,
you can always join the ^4d4dffEden Group^000000.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
如果不知道去哪儿找推荐人或发掘队，
可以先加入^4d4dff乐园团^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
If you've worked for the Group before, then you won't have a problem getting its referral.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
如果你以前为乐园团工作过，拿到他们的推荐信应该不难。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Hm...
I'm sorry, but my hands are tied.
This place is too dangerous for you at this moment.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
嗯...
抱歉，我也没办法。
你现在还不适合进入这里，太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Please come back when you become more experienced.
You must be at least Level 140 to register with us.
This is necessary, or we'll just have a ragtag bunch of novices for the excavators.
Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
等你经验更丰富些再来吧。
登记至少需要达到140级。
否则发掘队里全是新手可不行。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Come back with an official excavation team, or bring a referral.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
请带正式发掘队一起来，或者出示推荐信。

scripts.text:
Hello.
Thank you for using the Phantasmagorika excavation reception desk.
Do you have a referral? Or are you a member of an excavation team?
scripts.translation:
您好。
欢迎来到幻象嘉年华发掘接待处。
您有推荐信吗？或者是发掘队成员吗？

scripts.text: I'm from the Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 我是乐园团的人。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
From the Eden Group, got it.
May I have your name? {0}...
Ah, there you are.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
乐园团的，明白了。
请告诉我您的名字。{0}...
啊，找到了。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
You're a member of a separate excavation team.
Which excavation team do you belong?
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
您是独立发掘队的成员。
请问属于哪支队伍？

scripts.text:
[Nara]
...{0}...?
Are you sure that's correct?
Because I can't find that name on the list.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
...{0}...？
您确定名字没错吗？
我在名单上找不到。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Atnad... Atnad...
Oh, I've found it.
With you {0}, the team barely passed the minimum member requirement.
Oh, we don't discriminate against small groups. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
阿特纳德...阿特纳德...
啊，找到了。
加上您{0}，这支队伍才刚达到最低人数要求。
不过我们不会歧视小队，别担心。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Please check again.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
请再确认一次。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
While following the command of your excavation team leader,
you can also take on tasks available at the Central Command Center.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
听从发掘队队长指挥的同时，
你也可以接取中央指挥中心发布的任务。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
We'll inform you in case of special events.
If you're wounded or exhausted, you can always use healers on standby at the Command Center.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
有特别活动时我们会通知你。
如果受伤或累了，随时可以找指挥中心的待命治疗师帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Rekenber provides you with everything you need while working at the excavation site.
In return, we expect you to focus on uncovering secrets buried within Phantasmagorika.
Good luck with your excavation.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
发掘期间，雷根贝勒会提供所需的一切。
作为交换，希望你专心发掘幻象嘉年华中埋藏的秘密。
祝发掘顺利。

scripts.text:
Now you have unlimited access to this area.
Feel free to let us know if you experience problems excavating or exploring.
scripts.translation:
现在你可以随时进入这个区域了。
发掘或探索过程中遇到问题，欢迎随时告诉我们。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Your registration has been processed. If you need help or instructions, please talk to Commander Louis.
He'll also have some monster subjugation tasks available for you.
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
登记手续已经办好了。需要帮助或指示的话，请找路易斯指挥官。
他也会发布讨伐魔物的任务。

scripts.text:
[Nara]
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[娜拉]
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
How are you today?
Keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
今天怎么样？
继续加油。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Register yourself as an official excavator, or you'll be escorted off the premises.
You can register at the Reception Desk.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
请登记成为正式发掘人员，否则我们会请你离场。
可以到接待处办理登记。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
You're in the Atnad Excavation Team.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你是阿特纳德发掘队的成员。
有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Report excavation results.
scripts.translation: 报告发掘成果。

scripts.text: About cleaning the tunnel.
scripts.translation: 关于清理隧道。

scripts.text: About monster subjugation.
scripts.translation: 关于讨伐魔物。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Do you want to report results?
...There must be a seal of the head of the Atnad Archaeological Mission on the report!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
要报告成果吗？
...报告上必须有阿特纳德考古队队长的印章！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Ah, the excavation results of your team.
I can see your team has been focusing on the Core.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
这是你们队伍的发掘成果啊。
看来你们一直在研究核心区域。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
It was a brief investigation, yet your team has accomplished so much.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
调查时间虽短，你们队伍却已经取得了不少成果。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
The upper management is interested in
hearing more about your findings.
I hope you'll continue to surprise us.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
管理层很想
进一步了解你们的发现。
希望你们能继续带来惊喜。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Are you here to report your daily results?
Please bring me a report with your leader's signature on it.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你是来提交今天的成果报告吗？
请带上队长签字的报告。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Information like this will basically be made into a file.
Sorry to trouble you.
The content of the Atnad archaeological group Pick it up. must be very interesting, we are looking forward to it!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
这类资料通常会整理归档。
麻烦你了。
阿特纳德考古队的发现一定很有意思，我们很期待！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
The Chairman has taken a special interest in your team.
Keep up the good work, and you'll hear from him.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
会长特别关注你们的队伍。
继续努力，之后他会联系你们。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Thank you for your hard work today.
See you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
今天辛苦了。
明天见。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Oh, wait.
Your team is on the radio.
Let me put you on the line.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
哦，等等。
你们队伍正在用无线电呼叫。
我帮你接通。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad's Voice]
*Crackle* Hey... *Crackle* rookie...
*Crackle* What's wrong... with this...
*Crackle* I can't hear...
Rookie... *Crackle* Get your butt over here... *Crackle*
Hmpf! *Beep*
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德的声音]
*滋啦* 喂...*滋啦* 新人...
*滋啦* 这玩意儿...怎么了...
*滋啦* 我听不清...
新人...*滋啦* 给我过来...*滋啦*
哼！*哔*

scripts.text:
[Louis]
I'm sorry, the signals aren't usually so bad.
I guess the doctor is looking for you.
You should go.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
抱歉，平时信号没这么差。
看来博士在找你。
你最好过去一趟。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
While other scholars and excavators were only able to make superficial observations,
your team made some technical discoveries.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
其他学者和发掘者只能做些表面观察，
你们队伍却有了技术方面的发现。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
I'll report this to the Chairman, and see that your team will receive special benefits.
I'll look forward to your next report.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
我会向会长汇报，确保你们队伍获得特别待遇。
期待你们下次提交报告。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
It's always safe to leave a record.
Bring your report as soon as it's ready.
It always excites me to read your report.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
有记录总是好事。
报告准备好后请尽快送来。
我每次读你们的报告都很期待。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
The Chairman has taken a special interest in your team.
Keep up the good work, and you'll hear from him.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
会长特别关注你们的队伍。
继续努力，他之后会联系你们。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Thank you for your hard work today.
See you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
今天辛苦了。
明天见。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Ah, you came at the right time.
Monsters are growing more numerous in the tunnel and the ruins.
The mercenaries have requested reinforcements.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你来得正好。
隧道和遗迹里的魔物越来越多，
佣兵请求增援。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Thank you.
Move through the tunnel and get rid of monsters in there.
When you're done, please report the results to Manager Michell in the eastern ruins.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
谢谢。
穿过隧道，把里面的魔物清理掉。
完成后，请向东边遗迹的米歇尔管理员报告。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Did you take care of monsters in the tunnel and the ruins?
Our mercenaries will be happy.
They've been demanding reinforcements for a while now. Hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
隧道和遗迹里的魔物都处理好了吗？
我们的佣兵肯定很高兴。
他们催增援催了好一阵子了。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Our mercenaries can take care of monsters in the tunnel and the ruins.
But thank you for your concern for the safety of the site.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
隧道和遗迹里的魔物，我们的佣兵能处理。
不过还是谢谢你关心现场安全。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Are you concerned about monsters in the tunnel and the ruins?
If you're fully rested, then I can put you on the subjugation task.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你担心隧道和遗迹里的魔物吗？
如果休息好了，我可以安排你去讨伐。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
[Louis]
Ah, you came at the right time.
Threatening machines have appeared at the Plaza.
The workers have requested a combat unit.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你来得正好。
广场出现了危险的机器，
工人们请求派战斗小队支援。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
[Louis]
Thank you.
The Plaza is where most of the excavation work is being done.
It'll be great if you can find something from machines you destroy.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
谢谢。
广场是主要的发掘区域。
如果能从你摧毁的机器上发现什么就好了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
[Louis]
Things seems to have settled.
The workers will resume their work soon.
They're not fighters, so they're usually passive in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
情况似乎稳定下来了。
工人们很快就能复工。
他们不是战斗人员，遇到这种情况通常只能被动应对。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
[Louis]
I have other volunteers to take care of monsters at the Plaza, the main excavation point.
You should rest.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
我已经安排其他志愿者去处理主发掘区广场的魔物了。
你先休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
[Louis]
Are you concerned about the machines at the main excavation point?
It's true that some of them are hypersensitive and aggressive,
and I agree they are threatening to our work.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你担心主发掘区的机器吗？
确实有些机器反应过度、攻击性强，
我也认为它们会威胁发掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
[Louis]
[Louis]
Is that so?
Let me know if you notice anything peculiar.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
是吗？
发现什么异常就告诉我。

scripts.text: I'll go.
scripts.translation: 我去。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Of course, your priority is the excavation.
I'll look for someone else.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
当然，发掘才是你的首要任务。
我另找人去。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Good.
Thank you in advance.
When you're done, you can report the results to Manager Michell in the eastern ruins.
Happy hunting.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
好，先谢过你。
完成后向东边遗迹的米歇尔管理员报告结果。
祝你狩猎顺利。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Thank you for your hard work.
Please go rest, so that you can get back on the excavation task.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
辛苦了。
先休息一会儿，好继续参与发掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
If you're planning to go outside, you might as well take the task, killing two birds with one stone.
And you can report the results to Manager Michell in the eastern ruins.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你既然要出门，不如顺便接下任务，一举两得。
结果可以报告给东边遗迹的米歇尔管理员。

工人们很快就能复工。

You should rest.

你担心主发掘区的机器吗？
确实有些机器反应过度、攻击性强，
我也认为它们会威胁发掘工作。

[Louis]
[Louis]
Is that so?
Let me know if you notice anything peculiar.

是吗？
发现什么异常就告诉我。

scripts.text: I'll go.
scripts.translation: 我去。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝。
