[Louis]
Of course, your priority is the excavation.
I'll look for someone else.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
当然，发掘才是你的首要任务。
我另找人去。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Good.
Thank you in advance.
Please be careful!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
好，先谢过你。
请多加小心！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Thank you for your hard work.
Our workers will be grateful to you for keeping them safe.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
辛苦了。
工人们会感谢你保护了他们。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
If you can take care of them, then I can officially put you on the task,
so you'll be rewarded accordingly. Rekenber never takes your service for granted.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
如果你能处理这些魔物，我就正式把任务交给你，并按规定发放报酬。雷根贝勒不会亏待帮忙的人。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Is that so?
Let me know if you notice anything peculiar.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
是吗？
发现什么异常就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Miyo]
Please come in.
Where do you hurt?
scripts.translation:
[美代]
请进。
您哪里不舒服？

scripts.text: HP/SP full recovery 5,000 z
scripts.translation: HP/SP完全恢复 5,000 Zeny

scripts.text: HP/SP half recovery 2,000 z
scripts.translation: HP/SP恢复一半 2,000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Miyo]
...Look at you and you
can't pay for the treatment fee?
scripts.translation:
[美代]
...瞧你这样子，
连治疗费都付不起吗？

scripts.text:
[Miyo]
Oh, you're exhausted.
Let me restore {0} energy.
I'm offering a 10% discount to the official excavators.
Smile, and you'll feel better.
scripts.translation:
[美代]
哎呀，你累坏了。
我来帮你恢复{0}点能量。
正式发掘人员可享九折优惠。
笑一笑，感觉会好些哦。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
The old archaeologist has his back toward you, working on something.
You shouldn't disturb him.
scripts.translation:
那位老考古学家正背对着你忙着什么。
还是别打扰他吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ah, welcome.
I've been waiting for you.
First things first: you should go register with the Central Command Center.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
啊，你来了。
我一直在等你。
先去中央指挥中心登记吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Your name is already on the list. Just go check in with the center.
Or you won't have full access to this area.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
名单上已经有你的名字了，去指挥中心报到就行。
否则你无法进入这一区域的所有地方。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Come back when you're done. I'll introduce you to the other members.
Go on.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
办完后回来，我把其他队员介绍给你。
去吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ah, you're back.
Say hello to our leader, Ian Atnad.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
啊，你回来了。
来见见我们的队长伊恩·阿特纳德。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Rookie.
I don't have time for rookies. Send them back!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...新人。
我没空照顾新人，叫他回去！

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You're doing it again.
We're old now. We need help!
Stop being so stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
你又来了。
我们都老了，需要帮手！
别这么固执。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Hey, rookie.
Did my daughter send you to spy on me?
Tell me!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...喂，新人。
我女儿派你来监视我的吗？
说！

scripts.text: I came to help.
scripts.translation: 我是来帮忙的。

scripts.text: I don't know what you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Hm? Don't you know who my daughter is?
Well, we should leave it that way.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
嗯？你不知道我女儿是谁？
那最好就别知道。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That means you know who my daughter is.
Do you really think you can work with me?
Knowing who I am?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
既然知道我女儿是谁，
你还觉得自己能跟我共事吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Well, fine.
Let's get to work.
I want to know if you can follow my orders.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
行吧。
开始干活。
我倒要看看你听不听我的命令。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ian, you're helpless.
Well, welcome to the team, young adventurer.
Some of the things we're planning are physically challenging, not to mention dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
伊恩，你真拿他没办法。
欢迎加入队伍，年轻的冒险者。
我们安排的工作有些很耗体力，而且相当危险。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Enough. Rookie, come over here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
够了。新人，过来。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I'm sorry.
You'd better go.
Don't let him get on your nerves.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
抱歉，你还是先过去吧。
别把他的话放在心上。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Thank you for your patience with Ian.
He wasn't always like that.
He's doing it on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
谢谢你对伊恩这么有耐心。
他以前不是这样的。
他是故意刁难你。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
If you're done with him, I can use your help.
We have one more member in the team.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
你和他谈完后，我还需要你帮忙。
队里还有一位成员。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
He went to the Plaza to investigate the remains.
He's a young fellow named ^4d4dffLloyd^000000.
I sent Luke with him to keep him safe,
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
他去广场调查遗迹了。
是个叫^4d4dff劳埃德^000000的年轻人。
我派卢克陪着他，确保安全，

scripts.text:
[Aures]
but I want to know how much progress Lloyd has made with his investigation.
Could you go check up on him?
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
不过我想知道劳埃德的调查进展如何。
你能去看看他吗？
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Lloyd must be somewhere in the Verus Central Plaza.
Look for Luke. He should be near Lloyd.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
劳埃德应该在维鲁斯中央广场某处。
去找卢克，他应该就在劳埃德附近。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
He's the only young member aside from you.
The rest of the members of our team are as old as me, and couldn't make the trip.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
除了你，他是队里唯一的年轻人。
其他队员都和我一样老，没法长途跋涉。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Please take good care of
Lloyd.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
请好好照看
劳埃德。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
How's Lloyd doing?
Ah, so you're helping him.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
劳埃德怎么样？
哦，原来你在帮他。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Thank you
for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
They're here to work for us.
Stop thanking them.
They're spoiled as it is.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
他们是来给我们干活的。
别谢他们。
他们已经够娇气了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Sigh, would you stop?
*Shaking his head*
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
唉，你能不能消停点？
*摇摇头*

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ah, you're back.
How's Lloyd doing?
He wants to camp there.
Wouldn't it be too dangerous? I guess Luke can keep him safe.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
啊，你回来了。
劳埃德怎么样？
他想在那里扎营。
会不会太危险了？不过卢克应该能保护他。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Please come this way.
I wrote a report while waiting for you.
I want you to take it to Commander Louis at the Central Command Center.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
请这边走。
等你的时候我写了份报告。
麻烦你送到中央指挥中心交给路易斯指挥官。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
This may be a simple errand,
but it gives you an opportunity to get acquainted with the Commander.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
这差事虽然简单，
但也能让你有机会认识一下指挥官。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
We're old, so we don't care about fame. You're different.
Winning favor with Rekenber
can go a long way.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我们上了年纪，不在乎名声。你还年轻，不一样。
得到雷根贝勒赏识，对你前途大有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Please take that report to Commander Louis.
Writing a report every day is a chore, but an important chore nonetheless.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
请把报告交给路易斯指挥官。
每天写报告虽然麻烦，却很重要。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I've noticed Louis has been watching us. I hope that's a good sign.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我发现路易斯一直在关注我们，希望这是个好兆头。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Did you deliver the report?
Good.
You can take a break now.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
报告送到了吗？
很好。
你可以休息了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
No, you can't!
You've got work to do!
Come over here, now!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
不行！
你还有活要干！
现在过来！

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I don't understand him sometimes.
I feel sorry for you.
I wish I could help.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
有时候我也搞不懂他。
真替你难受。
希望我能帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Maybe the other youngsters can give you better advice.
^4d4dffWhy don't you consult Lloyd or Luke?^000000
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
也许其他年轻人能给你更好的建议。
^4d4dff去问问劳埃德或卢克吧？^000000

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Sigh, he's as stubborn as a mule.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
唉，他倔得像头驴。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I heard that.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我听见了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Then stop it
and stop harassing them.
The Eden Group won't be happy if it knows about this.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
那就别再找他们麻烦了。
乐园团要是知道这事，可不会高兴。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The Eden Group? *Snort* Who cares?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
乐园团？*哼* 谁在乎？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You're helpless.
I'm really, really sorry about him.
You really should talk to those two.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
真拿他没办法。
他这样我实在很抱歉。
你还是去找那两个人谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
So you've found some clues, eh?
Hm, even I'm excited.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
你找到线索了？
嗯，连我都兴奋起来了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Please take that report to Commander Louis.
Writing a report every day is a chore, but an important chore nonetheless.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
请把报告交给路易斯指挥官。
每天写报告虽然麻烦，却很重要。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I've noticed Louis has been watching us. I hope that's a good sign.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我发现路易斯一直在关注我们，希望这是个好兆头。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You came back at the right time.
I've made some progress with my research with the Power Control Devices you brought.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
你来得正好。
用你带来的动力控制装置做研究，我已经有些进展了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I just finished writing a report about it
along with the energy source that Lloyd is studying.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我刚写完一份报告，
里面也整理了劳埃德正在研究的能源资料。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Here's the report.
Please ^4d4dffbring it to Louis
at the Command Center^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
报告在这里。
请^4d4dff把它交给指挥中心的路易斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ian is working on Power Control Devices.
Lloyd is working on the power supply for the devices.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
伊恩在研究动力控制装置，
劳埃德则在研究装置的供能方式。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Well, that leaves me with the menial task of organizing documents.
Could you help those two?
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我嘛，只剩下整理文件这种杂活了。
你能去帮帮那两个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
The quicker we gather research materials, the quicker we can report.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
研究材料收集得越快，我们就越快能提交报告。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Did you deliver the report?
It may be a simple errand,
but it gives you an opportunity to get acquainted with the Commander.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
报告送到了吗？
虽然只是跑个腿，
但也能让你有机会认识指挥官。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
We're old, so we don't care about fame. You're different.
Winning favor with Rekenber can go a long way.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我们上了年纪，不在乎名声。你还年轻，不一样。
得到雷根贝勒赏识，对你前途大有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
So let's have you submit reports from now on.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
今后就由你来提交报告吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It's time we write another report.
I'll do it after I'm done studying Power Control Devices.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
该写下一份报告了。
等我研究完动力控制装置就动笔。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
... that's distracting.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...真碍事。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What have you been loafing around for?
Who the hell is this?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你在那儿磨蹭什么？
这家伙是谁？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So, you said you will help us with our work?
Then let's see how well you do.
There is a plaza if you leave this area and go further inside.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你说要帮我们干活？
那就让我看看你有几斤几两。
离开这里再往里走，有个广场。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
20 Power Control Devices.
Should be no problem for one who is recommended by that supposedly great person, should it?
Hm.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我要20个动力控制装置。
那个所谓大人物推荐来的人，应该办得到吧？
哼。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
.. Hm..
Don't get smug because of this!
We will use that for research.
Hand over everything you have.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...嗯...
别拿这点事就得意！
这些东西要拿来研究。
全都交出来。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...I still don't trust you.
There's a thing called a contract so I'd like it you just quietly keep working.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...我还是不信任你。
既然签了契约，你就老老实实继续干活。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
....you..
Why don't you go find something to work on instead of playing around?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...你啊...
别在这儿闲逛，找点活干去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Are you coming back from sending the report?
Good timing.
Bring me something to snack on.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你送完报告回来了？
来得正好。
给我找点零嘴来。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Are you going to make me repeat myself?
Find me a ^4d4dffdelicacy that is simple to eat yet juicy and refreshing and has a neat finish^000000
and I will grant you what you want.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
还要我重复一遍吗？
给我找一道^4d4dff方便入口、多汁清爽、回味利落的美味^000000，
我就答应你的要求。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
..Hm.
Giving up?
Are you really?
I didn't see you as someone who would give up so easily..?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...嗯。
要放弃了吗？
你确定？
我还以为你不会这么轻易放弃呢...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Hm.. is this it?
......Can I indeed eat this conveniently during work without separate silverware.
..Smells of freshly cooked meat.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
嗯...是这个吗？
...工作时不用餐具就能吃，倒是挺方便。
...闻起来像刚烤好的肉。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Have you arrived?
Have you adjusted to the excavation site?
So what is it this time.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你到了？
适应发掘现场了吗？
这次又有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You're finally here.
So, did you get any results?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你总算来了。
有进展吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Find that child Arquien, and bring back the record player.
She must give me at least that much.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
去找那个叫阿奎恩的孩子，把留声机带回来。
她至少该把这个还给我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I cannot tell what that child is up to.
If she has a problem with me tell her to come and say it to me directly!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我真搞不懂那孩子在想什么。
她要是对我有意见，就当面来告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Did you see some results this time?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
这次有发现什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You will find the restricted area if you go to the connected path North-west of the plaza area.
We have an excavation permit so you can enter.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
从广场区域往西北走，沿着连接通道就能找到管制区。
我们有发掘许可，你可以进去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
This time too!
Why.. why is that child acting like this!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
又是这样！
那孩子为什么...为什么要这样！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Have you arrived?
In fact I have been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你来了？
其实我一直在等。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I will leave deciphering the Memory Records up to you and Arquien for the time being.
Since you say you won't ask about the Last Exploration any more..
What is it today?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
暂时由你和阿奎恩负责解读记忆记录。
既然你说不再追问最后一次探索的事了...
今天有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What are you doing? Hurry up.
^4d4dffRekenber Headquarters is in Lighthalzen^000000.
You go on ahead. Let's meet there.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你在磨蹭什么？快点。
^4d4dff雷根贝勒总部在拉赫^000000。
你先过去，我们在那里碰头。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You can never know what will happen.
I guess I should be happy with exclusive rights to the Memory Records.
What is it today?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
谁也说不准接下来会发生什么。
能独占记忆记录的权利，我想也算值得高兴吧。
今天有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ian, why are you like this?
This young adventurer was dispatched here from the Eden Group.
He is here to help us.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
伊恩，你怎么又这样？
这位年轻冒险者是乐园团派来帮忙的。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
..Hm... Rookie.
I do not need such favors, send them back!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...嗯...新人。
我不需要这种好意，叫他回去！

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I see he is acting like this again..
Do you think a bunch of old men can do this task easily?
Stop being so stubborn for a change.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
你看，他又来了...
你觉得一群老头子能轻松完成这项工作吗？
偶尔也别这么固执。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
..Hey, Rookie.
Are you here to monitor me on my daughter's orders?
Is that it?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...喂，新人。
你是奉我女儿的命来监视我的？
是这样吗？

scripts.text: Just here to help.
scripts.translation: 我只是来帮忙的。

scripts.text: That is news to me.
scripts.translation: 这我倒不知道。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Hum? You did not hear about my daughter?
Then I don't need to bring up such idle talk.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
嗯？你没听说过我女儿？
那就不必聊这种闲话了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...so you know about my relationship with my daughter?
So are you trying to stay silent and just do your work?
You are trying not to involve yourself?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...所以你知道我和女儿的关系？
你是打算什么也不说，只管埋头干活？
不想掺和进来？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Good.
Then I will order you to do something you really need right away.
Let's see how well you can follow my instructions.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
很好。
那我现在就安排一件急事给你做。
让我看看你有多听话。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
This fellow.. He is like this to the end.
Anyway, since we are here, I am at your service as well.
I'm afraid the work we want to do is a bit dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
这老家伙真是固执到底...
既然都来了，我也随时听候差遣。
不过我们要做的事恐怕有些危险。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Stop talking nonsense and come here, Rookie.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
少说废话，过来，新人。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Sorry for this.
Let's us go first.
I have your back.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
抱歉啊。
我们先走吧。
我会照应你的。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
There will be machines from a highly advanced civilization.
There is an essential device to make the machines run.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
那里有来自高度发达文明的机器。
有一种关键装置能让机器运转。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
For now, there is something temporarily called the ^4d4dffOperation Control Device^000000 because it is still under investigation.
Investigate the machine and collect 20 of the Operation Control Devices.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
还在调查中，所以暂时叫它^4d4dff动力控制装置^000000。
去检查那些机器，收集20个动力控制装置。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I will see how well you work.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我会看看你干得怎么样。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Haha.. This guy is stiff as always.
Is it that hard to say one word of thanks for a job well done?
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
哈哈...他还是老样子，死板得很。
工作做得不错，连句谢谢都不肯说吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Away with you!
Why do you keep interfering.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
走开！
你怎么老来碍事？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It is one of the few joys this old man has, so what can you do.
I will thank you instead.
Anyway, thanks for your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
这可是我这老头少有的乐趣之一，没办法。
我替他谢谢你。
总之，辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You will probably focus on this kind of work in the future.
We wanted to study these operation devices butwe didn't know how terrifying those machines were.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
以后你大概会经常做这类工作。
我们本想研究这些动力装置，可之前不知道那些机器有多危险。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I will write the report soon so I will ask for you help then as well.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我很快要写报告，到时还得请你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You two are getting along well.
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你们俩倒是相处得不错。
快走开！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You're expecting a word of thanks to come out of me...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你还指望我说谢谢吗...

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Hey. Leave that stubborn fellow and come here for a minute!
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
嘿，别理那个固执的家伙，过来一下！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...... huh.. what are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...嗯？你在干什么？走开！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I am saying this once more,
I don't think you are here just to help us.
I am sure Arquien is up to something.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我再说一次，
我不信你只是来帮忙的。
阿奎恩肯定在搞什么鬼。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
.....hm.
Quickly come back to me after you are done with what you are doing.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...嗯。
你忙完手头的事就赶紧回来。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Not the rations supplies here.. what is that?
Find some delicacy to stimulate my appetite since it's hot and stuffy.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
这儿没有口粮...那是什么？
天气又热又闷，找点开胃的美食来。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Hey buddy. What kind of delicacy are you looking for here?
Just take what Louis brought.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
嘿，伙计，你到底在找什么美味？
直接拿路易斯带来的东西不就好了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Ah, you stay out of this.
This is for the rookie to handle by themself.
Find me a ^4d4dffdelicacy that is simple to eat yet juicy and refreshing and has a neat finish^000000!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你别插手。
这是给新人的任务，让他自己想办法。
给我找一道^4d4dff方便入口、多汁清爽、回味利落的美食^000000！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If you find what I want then I will listen to one wish of yours.
Are you not here in hopes of getting something?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
找到我想要的东西，我就答应你一个要求。
你来这里不就是有所求吗？

scripts.text:
In order to ask Ian Atnad about the ^4d4dffLast Exploration^000000
it seems a ^4d4dffdelicacy that is simple to eat yet juicy and refreshing and has a neat finish^000000 has to be found.
scripts.translation:
为了向伊恩·阿特纳德打听^4d4dff最后一次探索^000000，
看来得先找到一道^4d4dff方便入口、多汁清爽、回味利落的美食^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If it's hard for you find it with that dimwitted head of yours then try to ask others at least!
Something that will suit my taste.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你那笨脑袋找不到的话，至少去问问别人！
找点合我口味的东西。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If what I requested is that difficult I will take it back.
However, you must leave this excavation team.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
要是我的要求对你来说太难，我可以收回。
不过你得退出发掘队。

scripts.text: I must find the lost Beef Toast somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我得想办法找到丢失的牛肉吐司。

scripts.text: Ian wipes his hands and slowly starts to eat the Beef Toast.
scripts.translation: 伊恩擦了擦手，慢慢开始吃牛肉吐司。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Um...
.....!
This... this flavor!
Packed with the juiciness of finely ground beef!
I can taste the flavor of direct fire..!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
嗯...
...！
这...这味道！
细细绞碎的牛肉，汁水饱满！
还有炭火直烤的香气...！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Exotic fruit and vegetables reel in the subtle greasiness of the oil!
...!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
异国水果和蔬菜恰到好处地化解了油腻！
...！

scripts.text: Try the leaves that are wrapped around the outside.
scripts.translation: 试试外面包着的叶子。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Indeed.. this can be consumed as well.
Rich juiciness and fresh salad.. sweet fruit..
A fresh finishing flavor to wrap all of it up..!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
确实...这也能吃。
浓郁的肉汁，新鲜的沙拉...香甜的水果...
最后还有清爽的余味，完美收尾...！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Kid..
Not bad.
You have satisfied all the conditions I have laid out.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...小子...
不错。
你完全满足了我提的条件。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I have no choice.
Alright. I predicted there was something you wanted.
A promise is a promise. What do you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我也没办法。好吧，我早就猜到你有所求。
说过的话算数，你想要我做什么？

scripts.text: To know about the Last Exploration
scripts.translation: 我想知道最后一次探索的事。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
... so that was it.
I see....
To talk about that..give me some time to think.
....
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...原来如此。
我明白了...
关于那件事...给我点时间想想。
...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I need time to organize it as well.
.......
Come back later.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我也得花点时间整理思绪。
...
过些时候再来。
拜托了。

scripts.text: About the excavation project
scripts.translation: 关于发掘项目。

scripts.text: Converse
scripts.translation: 交谈。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It's good that you're here.
The access permit for the Laboratories and Research facilities dropped apparently.
So we plan to expand the investigation area..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你来得正好。
实验室和研究设施的通行许可似乎下来了。
所以我们打算扩大调查范围...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The position of our excavation team has improved quite a bit due to your actions.
Thanks to you we received permission to explore closed areas.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
多亏你的努力，我们发掘队的地位提高了不少。
我们终于拿到许可，可以探索封锁区域了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
They say the Research facilities area is connected to the road going up from the right side of the plaza.
Well, if you get up there the corporate bastards will be there restricting access.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
听说研究设施区连着广场右侧向上的道路。
不过到了那里，公司那帮混蛋会拦着不让进。

scripts.text: What about the Last Exploration!
scripts.translation: 那最后一次探索的事呢！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
..the Last Exploration, it wasn't much.
The exploration site was Juperos.
There were various goals but..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...最后一次探索，没什么特别的。
地点在朱佩罗斯。
当时有好几个目标，不过...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I know well that it was a major turning point for my life.
I feel like there is fog in my head.
And I think I will find another turning point here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我很清楚那是我人生的重要转折点。
可我脑子里像蒙了层雾。
我觉得自己会在这里找到另一个转折点。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It is just a feeling though.
I don't think the place I've been looking for and this place are related.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
不过这只是我的感觉。
我一直在找的地方，应该和这里没什么关系。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So won't you help me for the time being?
....
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
所以眼下你愿意帮帮我吗？
...

scripts.text: I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 我也没办法。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Yes, this is the last task.
Arquien has to know, too.
We will start soon so come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
没错，这是最后一项任务。
阿奎恩也必须知道。
我们很快就开始，准备好后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So we are trying to expand the investigating area.
But it seems there was a reason it was shut down.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
所以我们打算扩大调查范围。
不过看来那里被封锁是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It seems there are a lot of machines in that area that react sensitively to organisms.
Furthermore there was a veil of peculiar energy..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
那个区域有很多机器会对生物产生强烈反应。
而且还笼罩着一层奇异的能量...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Check out the Research facilities area first.
Let me know if there is anything peculiar.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
先去研究设施区看看。
发现什么异常就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If you find something worth risking danger for come back right away and tell me!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
要是发现什么值得冒险的东西，马上回来告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Let's look around as well instead of just working.
These kind of opportunities are rare.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
别光顾着干活，也四处调查一下。
这种机会可不多。

scripts.text:
You're finally here.
So, did you get any results?
scripts.translation:
你总算来了。
有进展吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Hm...? Wh..what. What is that in your hand?!
How...can this be.
I didn't imagine I would see this here...?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
嗯...？什、什么？你手里拿的是什么？！
怎、怎么可能...
我没想到会在这里见到这个...

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Huh? What is it?
It looks like your eyes are going to pop out.
Let me share in the surprise.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
咦？怎么了？
你眼珠子都快瞪出来了。
让我也看看是什么让你这么惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
This..this is.
Is a Memory Record.. Didn't you talk about this to me once?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
这、这是...
记忆记录...你以前不是跟我说过这个吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
My great-grandparents had something that looked like this...
It is a type of recording medium that records voices and sounds.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我的曾祖父母好像有过类似的东西...
这是一种能记录人声和声音的媒介。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ooh... Is it magic?
I know a bit of picture magic that can preserve images seen by the eye..
Is it something similar?
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
哦...这是魔法吗？
我略懂一点能保存眼中所见影像的魔法...
和那个类似吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
No. This is not an application of magic.
This is purely a product of science. I've seen my great-grandparents use this to listen to songs or record voices.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
不，这不是魔法。
这是纯粹的科学产物。我见过曾祖父母用它听歌、录音。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
In my youth I thought it was merely a toy-like invention of my great-grandparents....
Now I wonder why they did not announce that technology.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
年轻时我只当它是曾祖父母做的玩具...
如今我倒想知道，他们为什么没公开这项技术。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It is a memory when I was very young but it looks just like this.
..can we know the contents of the Memory Record with that.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
这是我小时候的记忆，不过它看起来确实一模一样。
...我们能用它读取记忆记录里的内容吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I need that! I see!
That..
...Ah....
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我需要那个！我明白了！
那个...
...啊...

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Hey, there. Are you okay?
Isn't the device that can decipher it in your house?
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
喂，你没事吧？
能解读记忆记录的设备不是在你家吗？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You.. ah...
I see. Ahahahahaha..
This guy. You don't know where your house is?
Ahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
你...啊...
我懂了。啊哈哈哈...
你这家伙，连自己家在哪都不知道？
啊哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
.... Didn't you say Arquien disposed of the house..?
We can easily figure it out if only we had the record player.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...你不是说阿奎恩把房子卖掉了吗？
只要有留声机，我们就能轻松解读了。

scripts.text: ..What? Why are you looking at me?
scripts.translation: ...什么？你为什么看着我？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You're that child's informant!
So go there and bring back the ^4d4dffrecord player^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你是那孩子的信使！
去把^4d4dff留声机^000000带回来。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I see. The one who can easily talk to her right now is you.
If it's okay we would like to ask you to do so.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我明白了。现在你最容易和她沟通。
方便的话，就请你去一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Why in the world is she not going to give it!
Then are you going to go and listen to it every time?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...她到底为什么不肯交出来！
难道你要每次都跑去听吗？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Well, that's not bad either.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
嗯，那倒也不错。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Yeah, not bad.
Not!
Anyway.. Since it turned out like this you make sure to bring it. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
对，不错。才怪！
总之，既然事情都这样了，你一定要把它带回来，听见没有？

scripts.text: Tell him the contents of the Memory Record.
scripts.translation: 告诉他记忆记录里的内容。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Any chance you misheard it?
Why is Atnad mentioned there?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...你确定没听错吗？
里面为什么会提到阿特纳德？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You never know.
Since you had the record thing in your house, could it be you are a descendant of this city?
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
谁知道呢。
你家里既然有那种留声机，难道你是这座城市的后裔？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I am... a descendant of this city..Verus?
Then why has this place been uncovered now?
Shouldn't we have known of this place much sooner?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我是...这座城市...维鲁斯的后裔？
那这里为什么现在才被发现？
我们不应该早就发现这里了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
No no. It was strange.
That's why Juperos.. That's why Juperos wasn't unfamiliar to me so I latched on.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
不，不对劲。
难怪我总觉得朱佩罗斯...朱佩罗斯对我来说并不陌生，所以才一直追查下去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If my ancestors are of this city.. why did they keep it a secret?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
如果我的祖先来自这座城市...为什么要隐瞒？

scripts.text: That we don't know.
scripts.translation: 我们也不知道。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Yes.. yes. Of course we do not know.
It seems we will have to find more of those Memory Records to know more.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
是啊...当然不知道。
看来得找到更多记忆记录，才能弄清楚真相。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I am sorry, but.. you went to the Research facilities, right?
Do you know of the enormous underground facility discovered near the laboratories?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
抱歉...你去过研究设施区了吧？
听说实验室附近发现了一处巨大的地下设施。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
First time hearing of it?
.. It seems things like Memory Records are being found in that underground facility as well.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你第一次听说吗？
...看来那处地下设施里也发现了记忆记录之类的东西。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Let's take the initiative before the others start to get interested.
The others can't decipher the messages anyway.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
趁别人还没注意到，我们先下手为强。
反正他们也看不懂那些信息。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
And, if we gather enough Memory Records.....
Go to Arquien and find out the... ugh... contents.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
还有，如果我们收集到足够多的记忆记录...
就去找阿奎恩查明...呃...里面的内容。
听明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
But I hear there are strange robots that are acting aggressively so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
不过听说那里的机器人很古怪，攻击性也强，小心点。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Come back after you find the entry path to the underground facility there.
Remember ^4d4dffcollecting Memory Records from the laboratories is the goal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
找到通往地下设施的入口后就回来。
记住，^4d4dff目标是从实验室收集记忆记录^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
At least five? We need five to decipher it right?
Collect them and go to Arquien.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
至少要五个？解读需要五个，对吧？
收集好后去找阿奎恩。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What? She wants to participate in this project too?
She will regularly decipher the Memory Records and send the results..?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
什么？她也想参与这个项目？
她会定期解读记忆记录，再把结果发过来...？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Why is she doing this. And so suddenly..?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...她为什么突然要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It seems she's become aware of something as well.
Is this not a good thing?
Father and daughter can get along and figure out their ancestors' past.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
看来她也发现了些事情。
这不是好事吗？父女俩还能一起了解祖先的过去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Is it?. Is there no other way?
Anyway, you go and see the results.
You have to check if Arquien is doing it correctly.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...是吗？就没有别的办法？
不管怎样，你去看看解读结果。
确认阿奎恩有没有弄错。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
We need somebody to collect the Memory Records as well?
Ahahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
还得有人去收集记忆记录吗？
啊哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Well, that's not untrue...
Anyway go along.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
嗯，说得也没错...
总之，去吧。

scripts.text: Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation: 有什么不对吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Something wrong? Something is wrong.
Something is very wrong.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
不对劲？当然不对劲。
大有问题。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
Hello?
I am the Chief Secretary of Rekenber's Secretariat, W.H.
I have been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒首席秘书]
您好？
我是雷根贝勒秘书处的首席秘书，W.H.
我等你们很久了。

scripts.text: Chairman Rekenber's secretary?
scripts.translation: 雷根贝勒会长的秘书？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
That is right.
I serve Chairman Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒首席秘书]
没错。
我为雷根贝勒会长工作。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So, what's the mighty Chairman's secretary doing in a place like this?
I thought there were reports on the excavation being separately sent?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
堂堂会长秘书，怎么会来这种地方？
我以为发掘报告都是单独提交的？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
The chairman wants to meet all of you.
Come and visit the headquarters in Rihrtarzen anytime.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒首席秘书]
会长想见你们所有人。
随时都可以去拉赫的总部拜访。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
It would be better if you could visit as soon as possible..
We request the Memory Record content be left undisclosed for the time being.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒首席秘书]
最好尽快前往...
目前请暂时不要公开记忆记录的内容。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Why is that?
Why should we do that?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
为什么？
我们为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
Hm.. I think I know what you are going to say but...
Let's just say the time is not right yet.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒首席秘书]
嗯...我大概知道你想说什么，不过...
只能说，现在还不是时候。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
We invited you to discuss the details of that issue as well.
So it would better to visit soon, would it not?
We will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒首席秘书]
这次邀请你们，也是想商讨那件事的细节。
所以还是尽快过来比较好，对吧？
我们等着你们。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
What..is.. going on here..
Hey Ian, did you get on the wrong side of the corporation?
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
这...到底是怎么回事...
伊恩，你是不是惹上公司了？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I don't know!
We should go anyway since they told us to.
Hey you.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我也不知道！
不过既然人家请我们去，就去一趟吧。喂，你。

scripts.text: Me?
scripts.translation: 我吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Yes. You.
They say you have to accompany us.
Let's meet at the Rekenber Corporation Headquarters.
It's better to take care of things like this at once.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
对，就是你。
他们说你也得一起去。
雷根贝勒总部见。
这种事最好一次解决。

scripts.text: About the excavation project
scripts.translation: 关于发掘项目。

scripts.text: About the Memory Records
scripts.translation: 关于记忆记录。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If I think about it this kind of structure isn't bad either.
The content recorded in the Memory Records is what is important.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
仔细想想，这种安排也不错。
记忆记录里的内容才是重点。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I cannot figure out what Arquien is thinking.
It would be so much better for me to bring back the Record player.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我真猜不透阿奎恩在想什么。
要是能把留声机带回来就好了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Since I am getting results without moving a finger..
......Good.. I will think positively. Yeah.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
既然我什么都不用做就能拿到成果...
...好吧...往好处想。对。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What? She wants to participate in this project too?
She will regularly decipher the Memory Records and send the results..?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
什么？她也想参与这个项目？
她会定期解读记忆记录，再把结果发过来...？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It's odd she's like this now when she used to hate even dreaming of working.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
真奇怪，她以前连想都不想工作，现在怎么变成这样了？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It seems she's become aware of something as well.
Is this not a good thing?
Father and daughter can get along and figure out their ancestors' past.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
看来她也发现了些事情。
这不是好事吗？父女俩还能一起了解祖先的过去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Is that so? Is there no other way?
Anyway, it seems we need your help.
You have to check if Arquien is doing it correctly.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...是吗？就没有别的办法？
不管怎样，看来我们还得靠你帮忙。
去确认阿奎恩有没有正确解读。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
We need somebody to collect the Memory Records as well?
Ahahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
还得有人去收集记忆记录吗？
啊哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Well, that's not untrue...
^4d4dffWork with Arquien for the time being.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
嗯，说得也没错...
^4d4dff暂时和阿奎恩一起工作吧。^000000

scripts.text: About the excavation project
scripts.translation: 关于发掘项目。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The excavation project?
.. do you mean the Power Control Device?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
发掘项目？
...你是说动力控制装置？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Are you talking about today's work?
It may be obvious but it is to look for Power Control Devices.
...
..You don't have to do it if you don't want to.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你问今天的工作？
显而易见，就是去找动力控制装置。
...
...你不想做也可以不做。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It's always the same.
It's ^4d4dff20 Power Control Devices^000000.
Since we're already here, I want to do this right so try not to mess up.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
每次都一样。
就是^4d4dff20个动力控制装置^000000。
既然来了，就给我好好干，别搞砸。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You got it right again.
....
What are you looking at?
Drop what you brought and leave.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
这次也做对了。
...
看什么看？
把带来的东西放下，然后走人。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
We are researching it now.
It's possible we will render it useless from the experiments.
Anyway I am busy now so leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我们正在研究这些装置。
实验过程中可能会把它们弄坏。
我现在很忙，别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The Power Control Devices we recovered in the past are all broken.
They couldn't withstand all the experiments.
Just like the ones now.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
之前回收的动力控制装置全都坏了，
经不起那些实验。
这次的也一样。

scripts.text: [Ian Atnad]
scripts.translation: [伊恩·阿特纳德]

scripts.text: I will look for Power Control Devices.
scripts.translation: 我会去找动力控制装置。

scripts.text: It is too hard.
scripts.translation: 太难了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You? You definitely said you will find them yourself?
I have no reason to reject this offer.
Since you said you will do it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你？你刚才不是说要自己去找吗？
我没理由拒绝。
既然你主动提出，就交给你了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Collect 20 Power Control Devices this time as well.
If we can unravel the secret of Power Control Devices...
We should be able to fix the broken ones and use them ourselves, right?
It will be fun.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
这次也去收集20个动力控制装置。
要是能解开它们的秘密...
说不定就能修好那些坏掉的，自己拿来用，对吧？
想想就有意思。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
... And.. I feel like I've seen it.. feels like I will know it.
Like I will remember. If I research and research until it is stuck in my brain I am sure something will come of it.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...而且...我好像在哪见过它...感觉自己应该认识。
就像快要想起来了。只要不断研究，让它刻进脑子里，我肯定能发现什么。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If you aren't here to work then go away.
You're distracting me.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
不是来干活就走开。
别打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
......This time I will use it well without breaking it.
Let's slowly get into restoration as well.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
...这次我会小心使用，不把它弄坏。
也该慢慢研究怎么修复了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Arquien is like that too.
......Because she couldn't withstand it... ..
...Hoo..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
阿奎恩也一样...
...因为她承受不住...
...唉...

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
This is very dangerous,
It is best to leave here,
The front is about to face
the danger of extreme death.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
这里非常危险，
最好赶紧离开。
前方即将面对
致命的危险。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I've told you
everything I wanted to tell you.
I hope we'll meet again someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
我想告诉你的事情
都已经说完了。
希望我们能在别处再见。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I don't have a story to tell you at this moment.
I'm trying to rest my mind.
Why don't you go
rest for a while?
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
我现在没故事可讲，
正好休息一下脑子。
你也不如去
歇一会儿？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Adventurer,
what story
did you bring me?
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
冒险者，
你带来了
什么故事？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Listen to my story.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
听听我的故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Until then,
stay safe.
I'm leaving for someplace else
in search of new stories to tell.
You'll be on your way, I'll be on my.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
在那之前，
保重。
我得去别处
寻找新的故事了。
你走你的路，我走我的路。

scripts.text: ^ff0000You have not yet met the requirements to complete the quest.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000你尚未满足完成此任务的条件。^000000

scripts.text: Return the quest.
scripts.translation: 交还任务。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Please be safe.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
保重。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Maybe you're not ready
for that task just yet.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
也许你还没
准备好做那个任务。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Come back later,
and I'll have a new story ready for you.
Bye for now.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
过些时候再来，
我会为你准备一个新故事。
先告辞了。

scripts.text: - Tell your story. -
scripts.translation: - 讲述你的故事。 -

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Maybe there's
more to it than that,
but we wouldn't know
because it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
事情也许
不止如此，
可惜现在说什么
都太迟了。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Schwarzwald seems to be
split into
various political factions.
Political intrigues don't mean much
to wandering artists like me.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
修瓦尔兹巴尔德似乎
分裂成了
好几个政治派系。
我这种四处漂泊的艺人，
可不懂什么政治斗争。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Scholars are such a strange kind.
I can't fathom what joy they'd feel
in studying such a thing.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
学者真是奇怪。
我实在想不通
研究这种东西
有什么乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Only the gods know
who's right
and who's wrong.
I believe that applies to those scientists as well.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
谁对谁错，
只有神明知道。
我想那些科学家之间
也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
The advancement of technology doesn't always mean
the destruction of the old.
Technology cannot advance by itself.
Neither can medical science
and life research.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
科技进步
不一定就要
摧毁旧事物。
科技不会凭空发展，
医学和生命研究
也一样。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I'm not sure if the same thing
won't happen
in this excavation site
because even I can sense a dangerous shadow looming over it.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
我不确定
这处发掘现场
会不会重演旧事，
因为连我都能感觉到
危险的阴影
正笼罩着这里。

scripts.text: [Wandering Bard]
scripts.translation: [流浪诗人]

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Your story dampens my mood,
and I wasn't in a good mood to begin with.
Well, at least I'm glad to see you back in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
你的故事让我心情更沉重了，
而我原本心情就不怎么样。
不过，看到你平安回来，我还是很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I'm proud of you, though:
you've become acquainted with the president
and carried out a secret mission for him.
And I'm also glad to see you back in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
不过我真为你感到骄傲：
你不但认识了会长，
还替他执行了秘密任务。
更让我欣慰的是，你平安回来了。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Of course, to some people
my search for new stories
sounds meaningless.
I don't care, so long as I have
curious adventurers like you with whom to pass the time.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
有些人会觉得，
我到处搜寻新故事
毫无意义。
我不在乎，只要有你这样好奇的冒险者
陪我打发时间就够了。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Welcome back.
I really enjoyed this story of yours.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
欢迎回来。
我很喜欢你讲的这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
If you ask me,
I can't say which side is right or wrong.
Can you?
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
要我说，
我也分不清谁对谁错。
你呢？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Welcome back.
I really enjoyed this story of yours.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
欢迎回来。
我很喜欢你讲的这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Um,
at least that's what I've heard.
...Just forget I said that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
嗯，
至少我是这么听说的。
...刚才的话就当我没说。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
The general populace
only likes to hear about happy endings,
so let's focus on
the positive aspects of the story,
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
普通人
只爱听圆满的结局，
所以我们还是多讲讲
故事里积极的一面吧，

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Welcome back.
instead of
the dark,
depressing ones.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
欢迎回来。
那些黑暗、
令人沮丧的部分，
就少提一些。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
And about the last person you've met,
um...
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
至于你最后遇到的那个人，
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Never mind. I shouldn't even have said that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
算了，我不该提起这个。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
We can only watch
the factions conspire against each other
and hope for
the best.
As a bard, my duty is simply to spread the word to the public.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
我们只能看着各方势力
彼此算计，
盼望事情能有个好结果。
身为吟游诗人，我的职责就是把消息传给大众。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I'm glad to see you back in one piece.
And thank you
for such a valuable story.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
很高兴你平安回来。
也谢谢你带来这么珍贵的故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Sigh, I hate to say this,
but this will have to be the last time
we share stories with each other.
Thank you for telling me all those interesting tales.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
唉，真不想这么说，
但这大概是我们最后一次
分享彼此的故事了。
谢谢你告诉我这些有趣的经历。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Please give me some time.
I want to make a new song
based on the story you've just told me.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
给我一点时间吧。
我想把你刚讲的故事
写成一首新歌。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Please take this.
I hope
it'll be useful for you.
I hope we'll meet again someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
这个拿去。
希望
对你有用。
但愿我们能在别处再见。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I have to leave
in search of new stories.
You'll be on your way, I'll be on my.
Be safe.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
我得离开了，
去寻找新的故事。
你走你的路，我走我的。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
You should rest and regroup in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
趁这段时间
好好休息，整顿一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
In the Republic of Schwarzwald,
where science prevails over magic,
a giant corporation of men
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
在科学胜过魔法的
修瓦尔兹巴尔德共和国，
有一家由人类组成的
大型企业...

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Do you know the president of
the Republic of Schwarzwald?
Usually, commoners like you and me
could never dream of meeting such a prominent figure,
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
你听说过修瓦尔兹巴尔德共和国的总统吗？
一般平民百姓
根本不敢想象能见到
那样的大人物，

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I wonder where all these researchers
have come from.
They must be
from all over the globe,
seeking the thrills of discovering the unknown.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
这些研究人员
到底是从哪儿来的？
他们一定
来自世界各地，
为了探索未知、体验发现的刺激而来。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Are these people
helping each other?
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
这些人
是在互相帮助吗？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Scholars. Where do they draw the line at their research?
Drifters like you and me
have no care for the world, and I'm glad for that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
学者们啊，他们研究起来究竟有没有底线？
我和你这样的漂泊者
什么都不在乎，反而自在。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I've seen the same scenery
a long time ago,
when Odin Temple
was first discovered.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
很久以前，
奥丁神殿
刚被发现时，
我也见过类似的景象。

scripts.text: [Wandering Bard]
scripts.translation: [流浪诗人]

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
is rumored to conduct research
whose purpose is noble and questionable at the same time.
Do you know
what's going on behind the closed doors of the corporation?
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
据说那家企业正在进行某种研究，
目的既崇高又令人质疑。
你知道
公司那扇紧闭的大门后
究竟发生着什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
You should
look further into what that corporation is doing.
Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
你该
继续调查那家企业的所作所为。
小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
but rumor has it you can
if you can find his contact in Lighthalzen.
Not only can you meet the president,
but you can unlock some new adventure.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
不过传闻说，
只要在拉赫找到他的联系人，
就能见到他。
不仅能见到总统，
还会开启新的冒险。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Look for his contact,
and everything else will take care of itself.
Who knows?
The adventure of your life might await you.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
找到他的联系人，
其他事情就会水到渠成。
谁知道呢？
也许一生中最精彩的冒险正等着你。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I think the most daring kind of people are
scholars and researchers,
like those at the Juno Library...
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
我觉得最无畏的人
就是学者和研究员，
比如朱诺图书馆里的那些人...

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Oh, speaking of the Juno Library,
I know there's a scholar
who does the same kind of research,
you know,
looking at odd-looking things all day.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
说到朱诺图书馆，
我认识一位学者
也做类似的研究。
就是那种
整天盯着奇怪东西看的研究。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
You should
talk to that scholar.
He may open your eyes to a whole new world.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
你应该
去和那位学者谈谈。
他或许能带你见识全新的世界。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Rumor has it there's a mad scientist
in Juno, and a group of people are
trying to thwart his dangerous research.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
听说朱诺有个疯狂科学家，
还有一群人正试图阻止他进行危险的研究。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I'd say the statement is biased.
Maybe the scientist is sound,
and those people are dangerous.
Who knows? I would steer clear of both of them, though, if I were you.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
我觉得这种说法有些偏颇。
也许那位科学家才是理智的，
那些人反而很危险。
谁知道呢？换作是我，会离他们双方都远远的。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
In Hugel, there's a scholar
who's rumored to be obsessed with a dangerous experiment.
I want you to go find out
what it is he's after:
happiness or hollow ambition.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
毁葛有位学者，
据说沉迷于危险的实验。
去查查他到底追求什么：
幸福，还是虚无的野心。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Oh, that reminds me
of the story about
the two--no, three people related to Odin Temple.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
哦，这让我想起
奥丁神殿相关的
两个人——不，是三个人的故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I wonder if Hugel still has the signboard
to recruit excavators.
Would you go check it out?
I want to hear the story behind those excavators when you get back.
scripts.translation:
[流浪诗人]
不知道毁葛还挂着招募发掘者的告示吗？
你能去看看吗？
回来后我想听听那些发掘者背后的故事。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to continue. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Nice to meet you. I'm Kesler, chief of the Phantasmagorika Police.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
幸会。我是凯斯勒，幻象嘉年华警察队的队长。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Welcome to the Phantasmagorika Police.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
欢迎来到幻象嘉年华警察队。

scripts.text: The Phantasmagorika Police?
scripts.translation: 幻象嘉年华警察队？

scripts.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, do you want to know about us at the ^4E9867Phantasmagorika Police^000000? Why, thank you. Not many people are interested in what we do.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哦，你想了解^4E9867幻象嘉年华警察队^000000吗？谢谢你关心我们的工作，很少有人对这些感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
You may wonder why such a fresh site needs a policing unit. Well, there's a valid reason.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
你可能会好奇，这种新开发的地方为什么还要成立警队。原因很充分。

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 什么原因？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Have you heard of the ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000?
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
你听说过^F8081E末日祈祷团^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
They're a cult group propagating the end of the world. They vandalize in the name of their god.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
他们是宣扬世界末日的邪教组织，还打着神的旗号搞破坏。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
It's only recent that they appeared in Phantasmagorika, but they've done so much damage already that scholars and mercenaries have organized this policing unit.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
他们最近才出现在幻象嘉年华，却已经造成不少破坏，所以学者和佣兵一起组建了这支警队。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
The ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000 are mainly sighted around the ^82ABE9Verus Central Plaza^000000. If you encounter them, feel free to teach them a lesson or two.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
^F8081E末日祈祷团^000000主要出现在^82ABE9维鲁斯中央广场^000000附近。遇到他们的话，就给他们点教训吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Hah hah, we're short-staffed.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哈哈，我们人手不太够。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I understand your enthusiasm, but you should focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
我理解你的热心，不过眼下还是专心训练吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you for offering to help, but we can manage on our own.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
多谢你愿意帮忙，不过我们还应付得来。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I'm sorry, what did you say?
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
抱歉，你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
[Police Chief Kesler]
Wow, you're the first person to ever offer help. We're spread thin, dealing with the Doom Prayers and everything else at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哇，你是第一个主动提出帮忙的人。我们人手紧缺，还得同时对付末日祈祷团和其他事务。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Phantasmagorika is more dangerous than you think.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
幻象嘉年华比你想象的危险。

scripts.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Wow, you're the first person to ever offer help. We're spread thin, dealing with the Doom Prayers and everything else at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哇，你是第一个主动提出帮忙的人。我们人手紧缺，还得同时对付末日祈祷团和其他事务。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I haven't had time to hear about the work-related difficulties trat the members of my unit may be experiencing.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
我一直忙得抽不开身，还没机会了解队员们工作上遇到的困难。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Could you make a tour around Phantasmagorika and talk to the police officers?
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
你能在幻象嘉年华巡视一圈，和警员们聊聊吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然可以。

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 也许之后吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, I thought you wanted to help.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哦，我还以为你想帮忙呢。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
谢谢你。

scripts.text: You haven't met with all the members.
scripts.translation: 你还没见过所有队员。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Please come back when you have.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
见完他们再回来吧。

scripts.text: You've met with all my members. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 你已经见过所有队员了。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I'm glad none of them--Salgran, Gerev, Seiden, and Piffs--are having problems.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
很高兴萨尔格兰、杰列夫、赛登和皮夫斯都没遇到麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Please take this small token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
请收下这份小礼物，聊表谢意。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
If you are not busy tomorrow, could you come back and help me again?
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
如果明天有空，能再回来帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, is this your first time in Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哦，你第一次来幻象嘉年华吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
This site was only recently discovered, and therefore fairly safe. I can't think of anything you should be worried about...
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
这里最近才被发现，目前还算安全。我想暂时没什么可担心的...

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, strike that--there's one thing.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
等等，我收回刚才的话——确实有一件事。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
This ^82ABE9Verus Excavation Site^000000 is safe, but if you're planning to move to the ^82ABE9Verus Central Plaza^000000, then make sure you're prepared for the worst.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
^82ABE9维鲁斯发掘现场^000000还算安全，但如果你要去^82ABE9维鲁斯中央广场^000000，务必做好最坏的准备。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
By the way the excavation of this site just has begun, and everything in it must be kept in place until the excavation is over.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
这里才刚开始发掘，在工程结束前，所有发现的东西都必须保持原样。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
But those Doom Payers are making it impossible. Bah! %$#@#$#@
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
可那些末日祈祷团把一切都搅乱了。真是的！%$#@#$#@

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I'm going bald, worrying over them so much. I didn't have much hair to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
我都快愁秃了，本来头发就不多。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
...
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
...

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Um, didn't mean to rant about my hair.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
呃，我不是想抱怨自己的头发。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Just be careful not to break anything that has been discovered in this site.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
总之，小心别破坏现场发现的任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, didn't you bring some Doom Tokens a while ago?
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哦，你之前不是带来过末日代币吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I guess you haven't left? You must like being here. So do I. Hah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
看来你还没离开啊？你一定很喜欢这里。我也是，哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I guess you haven't left? You must like being here. So do I. Hah hah hah!
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, the Doom Prayers carry this ^F8081EDoom Token^000000.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
看来你还没离开啊？你一定很喜欢这里。我也是，哈哈哈！
[警长凯斯勒]
哦，末日祈祷团会带着这种^F8081E末日代币^000000。

scripts.text: What can I get in exchange for Doom
scripts.translation: 末日代币能换什么？

scripts.text: Give Doom Tokens.
scripts.translation: 交出末日代币。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I remember telling you this when you first brought Doom Tokens, but all right, I don't mind telling you again.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
我记得你第一次带末日代币来时就问过，不过没关系，我可以再说一遍。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Doom Tokens are exchangeable with Packing Envelope that is often found in the excavation site.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
末日代币可以兑换在发掘现场经常发现的封装信。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Scholars have found out the envelop activates various effects when opened.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
学者们发现，打开封装信会触发各种效果。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
The duration of the effects is short, but it's still better than nothing.
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, the Doom Prayers carry this ^F8081EDoom Token^000000.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
效果持续时间不长，不过总比没有好。
[警长凯斯勒]
哦，末日祈祷团会带着这种^F8081E末日代币^000000。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
You've brought {0} Doom Tokens. I can give you {1} Packing Envelopes.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
你带来了{0}枚末日代币，我可以给你{1}封封装信。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you, and keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
谢谢，继续努力。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Um, didn't you say you had Doom Tokens?
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
呃，你刚才不是说有末日代币吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, the Doom Prayers carry this ^F8081EDoom Token^000000.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哦，末日祈祷团会带着这种^F8081E末日代币^000000。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Where did you find this?
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
你是在哪里发现这个的？

scripts.text: Tell him where you found it.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你在哪里找到的。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you so much for helping us to maintain public peace.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
非常感谢你帮忙维护治安。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
You deserve a reward, but I can't think of anything good.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
你应该得到奖励，可我一时想不到给什么好。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, I've got an idea! Bring me ^F8081EDoom Tokens^000000, and I'll exchange them with ^4E9867Packing Envelope^000000.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
哦，我想到办法了！把^F8081E末日代币^000000交给我，我就用^4E9867封装信^000000和你交换。

scripts.text: Packing Envelope?
scripts.translation: 封装信？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
It's an envelope often discovered in the excavation site.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
那是发掘现场经常发现的一种信封。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Scholars have found out the envelope activates various effects when opened.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
学者们发现，打开这种信封会触发各种效果。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Would you like to exchange your Doom Tokens with Packing Envelope now? Or you can do it later.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
现在要用末日代币兑换封装信吗？也可以之后再换。

scripts.text: Exchange now.
scripts.translation: 现在交换。

scripts.text: Do it later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Sure, no problem. It's not like Doom Tokens have an expiration date.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
当然没问题，末日代币又不会过期。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
In exchange for your {0} Doom Tokens, I've given you {1} Packing Envelopes.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
我用你的{0}枚末日代币，换给你{1}封封装信。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you for your continue support in the subjugation of the Doom Prayers.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
感谢你继续协助讨伐末日祈祷团。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
This is the first thing I tell every new visitor: if you see the ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000, don't hesitate to report to the nearest police station.
scripts.translation:
[警长凯斯勒]
每位新访客来时，我都会先提醒：看到^F8081E末日祈祷团^000000，立刻向最近的警察局报告。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
