小石子不算。请带10块能握在手里的石头来。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
You're still busy, huh? No worries. Just tell Chief Kesler that everything's quiet in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
你还是很忙啊？没关系，告诉凯斯勒队长我负责的区域一切正常就行。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
*Chuckle* Did you pick up all the stones?
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
*轻笑* 石头都捡齐了吗？

scripts.text: I did.
scripts.translation: 捡好了。

scripts.text: Where are they?
scripts.translation: 石头在哪儿？

scripts.text: I don't have time for them.
scripts.translation: 我没空管这个。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
*Chuckle* Where are they? Pick them up, or the spirits of the victims will haunt you forever.
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
*轻笑* 石头在哪儿？快捡起来，不然受害者的灵魂会永远缠着你。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
*Chuckle* Look around--there are stones everywhere. Where did you find this stone, then?
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
*轻笑* 到处都有石头，看看周围吧。那你手里这块是从哪儿捡的？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
*Chuckle* Where are the stones? Please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
*轻笑* 石头呢？请带来给我。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
[Police Officer Seiden]
*Chuckle* Thank you. The spirits of the victims are appeased for now.
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
*轻笑* 谢谢，受害者的灵魂暂时平息了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
*Chuckle* Stones are everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
*轻笑* 石头到处都是。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
Search the ground. *Chuckle* Do I really have to tell you that?
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
看看地上。*轻笑* 这种事还要我提醒你吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
*Chuckle* Please leave your stones somewhere away from traffic. Beware the spirits of the victims!
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
*轻笑* 把石头放到不妨碍通行的地方。小心受害者的灵魂哦！

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Seiden]
*Chuckle* Got it. Keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[警员赛登]
*轻笑* 知道了，继续加油。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text: You disarmed all the traps you had to.
scripts.translation: 你已经拆除了需要处理的陷阱。

scripts.text: The ??? on the ground looks suspicious. What do you want to do?
scripts.translation: 地上的“???”看起来很可疑。要怎么做？

scripts.text: Examine.
scripts.translation: 检查。

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 不管它。

scripts.text: You've decided not to touch the suspicious object.
scripts.translation: 你决定不碰那个可疑的东西。

scripts.text: You've decided it's nothing.
scripts.translation: 你认定那没什么特别的。

scripts.text: You disarmed all the traps of the Doom Prayers.
scripts.translation: 你已经拆除了末日祈祷团所有的陷阱。

scripts.text: You picked up 10 large stones. Take them to the police officer.
scripts.translation: 你捡起了10块大石头。把它们交给警员吧。

scripts.text: You found a stone half-buried in the ground. Do you want to pick it up?
scripts.translation: 你发现一块半埋在地里的石头。要捡起来吗？

scripts.text: Pick it up.
scripts.translation: 捡起来。

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 不管它。

scripts.text: You've decided to leave the pebble.
scripts.translation: 你决定把这块小石子留在原地。

scripts.text: This pebble is too small to inflict serious damage when thrown.
scripts.translation: 这块小石子太小了，扔出去也伤不了人。

scripts.text: You picked up a dangerously large stone.
scripts.translation: 你捡起了一块大得危险的石头。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to continue. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
*Yum Yum*
Um, this meat is delicious!
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
*吧唧吧唧*
嗯，这肉真香！

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
[Police Officer Piffs]
Don't you worry. I'll keep this area safe.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
别担心，我会守好这片区域。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
[Police Officer Piffs]
Are you also helping other areas? Then come help me when you aren't busy!
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
你也在帮其他区域吗？不忙的时候再来帮帮我吧！

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Geez, are you working multiple sectors at the same time? You're superhuman.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
天啊，你同时负责好几个区域？简直超人！

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Rest assured, I am here.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
放心，有我在这里。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
*Yum Yum* Delish!
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
*吧唧吧唧* 真香！

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Hah hah! Hello again. Did the Chief send you?
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
哈哈，又见面了。是队长派你来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Welcome back. Did you find all the herbs?
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
欢迎回来，草药都找齐了吗？

scripts.text: [Police Officer Piffs]
scripts.translation: [警员皮夫斯]

scripts.text: He's chewing on meat.
scripts.translation: 他正嚼着肉。

scripts.text: He's chewing on meat.
scripts.translation: 他正嚼着肉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Oops.
My apologies; I shouldn't have been snacking in public.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
哎呀，抱歉。我不该在大庭广众之下吃东西。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Hello. My name is Piffs, and I'm a Sage. I came to study Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
你好，我叫皮夫斯，是一名贤者，来这里研究幻象嘉年华。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Did the Chief send you? This is great.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
是队长派你来的？太好了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
I'm running short on some supplies, but I can't leave my post unattended. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
我的补给快用完了，可岗位不能没人看守。能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 现在不行。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
I understand. If you change your mind, though, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
我理解。改变主意的话再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Hah hah hah, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
哈哈哈，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
This area is fairly safe, but my colleagues stationed at the Plaza are prone to injury caused by the Doom Prayers.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
这片区域还算安全，不过驻守在广场的同事常被末日祈祷团弄伤。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
I need to gather herbs for them, but like I said I can't leave my post unattended.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
我得替他们收集草药，可又不能擅离岗位。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
I know where some good herbs grow in this place. Could you gather them for me?
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
我知道这里哪些地方长着好草药，你能替我采一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
If you're not busy, I'd like to ask you to gather some more herbs. Is that okay?
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
你要是不忙，我想再请你帮忙采些草药，可以吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Thank you. Look around thickets, and you'll see some herbs. I won't need more than 10.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
谢谢。灌木丛附近就长着草药，帮我采10株就够了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
I understand. If you change your mind, though, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
我理解。改变主意的话再回来找我。

scripts.text: There you go.
scripts.translation: 给你。

scripts.text: Where can I find them?
scripts.translation: 我去哪里找？

scripts.text: I have a more pressing matter at hand.
scripts.translation: 我还有更急的事要办。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Thank you for helping me stock up on herbs.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
谢谢你帮我储备草药。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Where are the herbs you said you gathered?
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
你说采到的草药呢？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
This herb smells good. I think it'll make good garnish for meat... *Ahem* I'm not saying I want to eat it.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
这草药闻起来真香，拿来配肉肯定不错...*咳* 我可不是说想吃。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
No, I don't eat herbs. I just want to keep them in stock for my colleagues.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
不，我不吃草药。我只是想给同事储备一些。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Where can you find herbs?
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
草药在哪里能找到？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Look around thickets, and you'll see some herbs.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
灌木丛附近就长着草药，去找找看吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
I have taken away the herbs of your Gather the herb. So far, you have to leave first in a hurry!
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
我已经收下你为“采集草药”任务找到的草药了。你先赶紧离开这里吧！

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
You can leave now. I'll send word to the Chief.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
你可以走了，我会向队长报告。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Piffs]
Don't forget I need 10 herbs.
scripts.translation:
[警员皮夫斯]
别忘了，我需要10株草药。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text: This kind of thicket grows everywhere in Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation: 这种灌木在幻象嘉年华到处都有。

scripts.text: This thicket looks like it's hiding some herbs. What do you want to do?
scripts.translation: 这丛灌木似乎藏着草药。要怎么做？

scripts.text: Gather the herb.
scripts.translation: 采集草药。

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 不管它。

scripts.text: You've decided to forget about it.
scripts.translation: 你决定不理会它。

scripts.text: No herbs were found in the thicket.
scripts.translation: 灌木丛里没有找到草药。

scripts.text: Gathered the herb.
scripts.translation: 采到了草药。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Don't worry about him.
He knows what he's doing.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
别担心他，他知道自己在做什么。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
...?
Interesting.
He wants something ready to eat, juicy, refreshing, and clean-tasting?
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
...？
有意思。
他想要一道方便入口、多汁清爽、回味利落的美食？

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Did you forget the ingredients?
2 Meats, 1 Mora Mandarin, and 1 Banana.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
你忘了食材吗？
2份肉、1个莫拉柑橘和1根香蕉。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
This should suffice.
I haven't cooked it in a while, but the recipe is in my head.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
这些应该够了。
我有段时间没做了，不过食谱还记得。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
*Chuckle*
If you need more, it'll be easier to buy it from the Mora Village.
Do whatever it takes to win favor with that old man.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
*轻笑*
还要更多的话，去莫拉村买会比较方便。
想办法让那老头满意吧。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
This place is boring, just like everywhere else.
Aren't there stronger monsters?
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
这里真无聊，跟其他地方没两样。
就没有更强的魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Well, I've got an idea. Bring me some ingredients, and I'll cook something for you.
I'm pretty sure it'll fit the bill.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
嗯，我有主意了。把食材带来，我给你做点吃的。
我想应该符合他的要求。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
The problem is
the ingredients are difficult to find.
I've learned this recipe while traveling across dimensions.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
问题是，
这些食材很难找。
这道食谱是我穿越次元旅行时学会的。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Well, it'll be you who has to find the ingredients:
2 Meats, 1 Mora Mandarin, and 1 Banana. Can you get them?
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
那就得由你来找食材了：
2份肉、1个莫拉柑橘和1根香蕉。能找到吗？

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Some of the fruits grow near the ^4d4dffMisty Forest Labyrinth^000000.
You'll have to look hard for them.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
有些水果长在^4d4dff迷雾森林迷宫^000000附近。
你得仔细找找。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Some of the fruits grow near the ^4d4dffMisty Forest Labyrinth^000000.
...
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
有些水果长在^4d4dff迷雾森林迷宫^000000附近。
...

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Done.
This food should fit all the conditions you told me.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
好了。
这道料理应该符合你转述的所有条件。

scripts.text:
Luke gave you Mora's specialty food, Beef Toast.
It perfectly fits everything Ian said he wanted.
scripts.translation:
卢克给了你莫拉特色料理“牛肉吐司”。
它完全符合伊恩的要求。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Or you won't find the answer the Captain wanted.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
不然你就找不到队长想要的答案了。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Don't say that.
You'll jinx us.
I'm a brave Cat, but my claws can't even scratch those.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
别这么说，会招来厄运的。
我可是勇敢的猫，可爪子连那些机器都抓不坏。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Alright, alright.
But don't worry.
I'm not stupid.
I'll never put my charges in danger.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
好啦好啦，别担心。
我又不傻，绝不会让自己保护的人陷入危险。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You're
looking down your nose at me because I'm a Cat.
Tsk, tsk.
You Humans are so superficial.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你因为我是只猫就瞧不起我。
啧啧。
人类真肤浅。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You're looking down your nose at me because I'm a Cat.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你因为我是只猫就瞧不起我。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
This place is littered with broken robots and machines.
Clouds of physical energy are discovered near them.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
这里到处都是损坏的机器人和机器。
它们附近能找到物理能量团。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Oh, this is enough.
You're good.
My estimation of you went up a notch.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
哦，这些就够了。
干得不错。
我对你的评价又高了一点。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Soon I'll need your service on a daily basis.
Don't fret and take one for the team.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
很快我每天都要麻烦你了。
别紧张，就当为团队出一份力吧。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You know the drill: collect condensed energy.
You'll do that for me, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你知道该怎么做：收集凝结能量。
愿意帮我吧？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
All you have to do is collect energy that naturally gathers around the remnants of robots and machines.
I need 10 bottles every day.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你只要收集机器人和机器残骸周围自然聚集的能量就行。
我每天需要10瓶。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I think I like you!
Not as much as Aures and Luke, though.
All right, I'll make good use of this energy.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我觉得我开始喜欢你了！
当然还比不上奥雷斯和卢克。
好了，我会好好利用这些能量。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'm analyzing the collected energy.
...
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我正在分析收集来的能量。
...

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Hm, maybe I need to find a special storage method.
The energy dissipates so easily.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
嗯，也许得找种特殊的储存方法。
这种能量消散得太快了。

scripts.text: [Lloyd]
scripts.translation: [劳埃德]

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just keep your distance and mind your own business.
You and I will be fine so long as you don't steal my hard work.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
离我远点，管好自己的事。
只要你不偷我的研究成果，我们就能相安无事。

scripts.text: Are you Lloyd?
scripts.translation: 你是劳埃德吗？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Yeah. What's up?
Huh? Aures sent you?
To check up on my progress?
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
是啊，怎么了？
咦？奥雷斯派你来的？
来检查我的进度？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Oh, I'm in trouble.
I must live up to his expectations,
but my research has been stagnant.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
啊，这下糟了。
我得达到他的期望，
可研究一直毫无进展。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Hey, could you help
me with something?
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
嘿，能不能帮
我一件事？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然可以。

scripts.text: What is a Cat doing here?
scripts.translation: 猫怎么会在这里？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Unlike many from Malangdo Island, I've always been interested in new technologies and cultures.
I worked at companies, and I've learned alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
和绵绵岛上的许多同胞不同，我一直对新科技和文化很感兴趣。
我在公司工作过，也学过炼金术。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I came to Verus City when I heard the news of its discovery. I was told that I must be in an excavation team to be in the city.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
听说维鲁斯城被发现后，我就赶来了。听说必须加入发掘队才能进入。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Aures helped me to get in.
I'm also a member of the Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
是奥雷斯帮我进来的。
我也是阿特纳德发掘队的成员。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Sorry to interrupt,
but you're from the Eden Group to help the excavation team.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
抱歉打断一下，你是乐园团派来协助发掘队的吧？

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Your job is to help Lloyd.
You can't say no.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
你的任务就是帮劳埃德。
不准拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
He's right!
You're obligated to help me with my research!
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
他说得对！
你有义务协助我的研究！

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Let's cut to the chase.
Hey, Human help.
Get 10 empty glass bottles,
and collect condensed energy found around the remnants of robots.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
有话直说吧。
喂，人类帮手，去拿10个空瓶，
再收集机器人残骸周围的凝结能量。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
This place is littered with broken robots and machines.
Clouds of physical energy are discovered near them.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
这里到处都是破损的机器人和机器。
它们附近会出现物理能量团。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just bring empty bottles close to the energy, and it'll enter the bottles.
Bring me 10 bottles.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
把空瓶靠近能量，它就会装进瓶里。
给我带10瓶来。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我等你。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just bring empty bottles close to the energy, and it'll enter the bottles.
Bring me 10 bottles.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
把空瓶靠近能量，它就会装进瓶里。
给我带10瓶来。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You must be dumber than you look if you have to ask twice.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
还要问两遍？你看起来没这么笨啊。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You've made my job easier.
Finally, I can be useful to Aures.
If I find the cause of the condensation of energy and its possible applications, maybe
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
多亏你，我的工作轻松多了。
总算能帮上奥雷斯的忙。
如果我找到能量凝结的原因和用途，也许...

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Ian and I can reactivate the robots in this place.
That's what we've wanted all along.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我和伊恩就能重新启动这里的机器人。
这正是我们一直想做的。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Tell Aures I'm making progress.
Good job, Human.
I'll look forward to using your service again.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
告诉奥雷斯我有进展了。
干得好，人类。
下次还要麻烦你。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Why, do you have something else to do?
All right then,
I'll ask Luke to take me around.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
怎么，你还有别的事？
那好吧，
我叫卢克带我四处看看。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
I thought you'd never ask!
I've been itching for some action.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
我还以为你永远不会开口！
我早就手痒了。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
All you have to do is collect energy that naturally gathers around the remnants of robots and machines.
I need 10 bottles every day.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你只要收集机器人和机器残骸周围自然聚集的能量就行。
我每天需要10瓶。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Come back tomorrow.
Well, you might as well come back every day at this time.
You can't say no.
I need you.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
明天再来吧。
嗯，最好每天这个时候都来。
不准拒绝。
我需要你。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Are you dense?
That means I want to be left alone!
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你听不懂吗？
我说了我想一个人待着！

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'll need more bottles of the energy.
How are you?
Are you ready to take one for the team?
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我还需要更多瓶能量。
怎么样？
准备好为团队出力了吗？

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text: You don't have to collect more energy at this moment.
scripts.translation: 目前不用再收集能量。

scripts.text: You have enough ^4d4dffCondensed Energy^000000.
scripts.translation: 你已经有足够的^4d4dff凝结能量^000000。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffEmpty Bottle^000000 is required to collect Condensed Energy.
scripts.translation: 收集凝结能量需要^4d4dff空瓶^000000。

scripts.text:
A thick cloud of energy is visible between the broken pieces of metal.
Bring an empty bottle close to the waving edges of the cloud to collect the energy.
scripts.translation:
破碎的金属间有一团浓厚的能量。
把空瓶靠近能量团摇曳的边缘，就能收集能量。

scripts.text: Collected Condensed Energy!
scripts.translation: 成功收集到凝结能量！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you heading for Phantasmagorika?
It may be difficult to find. Let me give you some directions.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
你要去幻象嘉年华吗？
那里可能不太好找，我给你指个路。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Follow the road all the way up, and then head southwest.
Let me mark the location on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
沿着道路一直往上，再往西南走。
我在小地图上给你标出位置。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This place is fraught with formidable monsters, just like the other parts of the old Juperos.
Be safe in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
这里和旧朱佩罗斯的其他地方一样，到处都是强大的魔物。
旅途小心。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you heading for Phantasmagorika?
It may be difficult to find. Let me give you some directions.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
你要去幻象嘉年华吗？
那里可能不太好找，我给你指个路。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Go straight east, then follow the road south. You'll see a giant status at a corner.
Let me mark the location on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
先一直往东，再沿路向南。拐角处能看到一座巨大的雕像。
我在你的小地图上标出位置。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Who knew there's a hidden place behind a statue? It was pure luck that we found it.
The road to the place is dangerous. Please have safe travel.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
谁能想到雕像后面藏着一个地方？我们纯属运气好才发现。
通往那里的路很危险，路上小心。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika project?
This is the entrance to the newly discovered ruins in the east.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
你是幻象嘉年华发掘项目的参与者吗？
这里就是东边新发现遗迹的入口。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
There's a guide on the other side of the entrance to guide you to the excavation site.
Please get in before some monsters pounce on you.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
入口另一边有向导带你去发掘现场。
赶快进去，别被魔物袭击了。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Oh, the other side of the entrance is teeming with aggressive robots.
You'd better brace yourself.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
哦，入口另一边有一大群攻击性很强的机器人。
做好准备再过去。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika project?
As you know, you're at the entrance to Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[发掘向导]
你是幻象嘉年华项目的参与者吗？
如你所知，这里是朱佩罗斯的入口。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
I'm here to guide you to the excavation site connected to the inside of Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[发掘向导]
我会带你前往与朱佩罗斯内部相连的发掘现场。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
There are more guides spread across the inside,
so you can find them easily in case you get lost.
scripts.translation:
[发掘向导]
里面各处还有其他向导，
万一迷路也很容易找到他们。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
Thank you for your contribution to the development of mankind. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[发掘向导]
感谢你为人类发展贡献力量，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you a member of the Excavation Group?
Our chairman has personally ordered us to see to your safety so that you can focus on your excavation work.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
你是发掘队成员吗？
会长亲自命令我们保护你，让你能专心工作。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
We're here to support your excavation of Verus City.
Let us know if you experience any problems.
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
我们会协助你们发掘维鲁斯城。
遇到任何问题都可以告诉我们。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I hate using portable johns, but my bladder can't seem to hold very much. What about you?
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
我讨厌用移动厕所，可膀胱又不太争气。你怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Ack! Shoo! Don't come close! I'm saving myself for my future bride!
scripts.translation:
[雷根贝勒卫兵]
啊！走开，别靠近我！我要把自己留给未来的新娘！

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
Hm, the building was crushed by the stone wall.
The rest is almost pulverized to dust.
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
嗯，这堵石墙把建筑压垮了。
其余部分几乎都被碾成粉末。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
The terrain on which the village stands was formed in a different period, compared to this stone wall. At least that's my initial assessment.
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
据我初步判断，村庄所在的地层形成时期和这堵石墙不同。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
The underground village doesn't seem to be artificial, though I can't imagine how it can be formed naturally. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
这个地下村庄似乎不是人工建造的，可我实在想不出它如何自然形成。你怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
...Are you even listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
...你到底有没有在听我说？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
Sigh.
Let's go have lunch.
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
唉。
我们去吃午饭吧。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
好的，教授！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Schwarzwald may be the most scientifically advanced among the three states of Midgard, but it still doesn't hold a candle to this place.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
修瓦尔兹巴尔德或许是米德加尔特三国中科学最发达的，但和这里相比仍远远不及。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
The same goes for Juperos. If the scientific knowledge of this place passed down to Schwarzwald, it could have been much more powerful.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
朱佩罗斯也一样。这里的科学知识要是能传到修瓦尔兹巴尔德，他们肯定会强大得多。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Of course, that's based on my theory that the residents of this place were also Schwarzwaldians.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
当然，这得建立在我的理论之上：这里的居民也是修瓦尔兹巴尔德人。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
I feel like I'm going insane, stuck in this confined space.
Hey, how about I read your fortune for the day with my juggling balls?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
被困在这么狭小的地方，我都快疯了。
嘿，要不要我用杂耍球给你算算今天的运势？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Good, choose a color you like.
The color you choose will tell me your fortune.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
好，选个你喜欢的颜色。
我会根据颜色告诉你今天的运势。

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 红色

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 蓝色

scripts.text: Yellow
scripts.translation: 黄色

scripts.text: Green
scripts.translation: 绿色

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Dum, dum, dum! Your fortune for the day!
Let's me get the fortune paper inside the ball...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
咚咚咚！来看看你今天的运势！
让我从球里拿出运势签...

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Today is...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
今天的运势是...

scripts.text: [Pierrot]
scripts.translation: [皮埃罗]

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
The same boring day, like yesterday and the day before.
Only positive thinking will get you out of this funk. Smile and be nice to others, and maybe Lady Luck will brighten your day.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
和昨天、前天一样，又是平平无奇的一天。
积极一点才能走出低潮。保持微笑、善待他人，说不定幸运女神会眷顾你。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Ack, you shouldn't have gotten out of bed. Wherever you go, trouble follows.
I strongly recommend you stay at the Shelter for the day. Sleep off bad luck.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
哎呀，你今天就不该起床。走到哪儿都会碰上麻烦。
我强烈建议你今天待在避难所，睡一觉把霉运睡过去。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Not a bad day, but you'll have to work to enjoy some good luck.
Go to the Excavation Site and dig up some dirt. You may find some treasure.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
今天还不错，不过得靠努力才能迎来好运。
去发掘现场挖挖土，说不定能挖到宝藏。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
The luckiest day of your life! Wherever you go, you'll find wealth and friends.
Maybe you'll find some historic artifacts buried in this place. That'll be awesome, huh?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
这是你一生中最幸运的一天！走到哪儿都能遇见财富和朋友。
说不定还能挖出埋在这里的历史文物，太棒了吧？

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Do you like my reading? Or do you hate it?
Your future is pliable--you can shape it however you want.
Don't get too excited or depressed. Just stay focused on your goal.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
喜欢我的占卜吗？还是不喜欢？
未来掌握在你手里——想怎么塑造都可以。
别太兴奋或沮丧，专心朝目标前进吧。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
All right, come back if you want another reading.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
好了，想再占卜的话随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been an important figure in Verus City.
Piles of official documents are discovered in this room.
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
这栋房子的主人肯定是维鲁斯城的重要人物。
这个房间里发现了成堆的公文。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
Most of the documents contain petty civil complaints, like water problems and neighbor disputes.
All the documents, however, contain the initials, OX. I don't know if they're of a name or an abbreviation of some sort.
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
大多是些琐碎的民事投诉，比如供水问题、邻里纠纷。
不过每份文件上都有“OX”字样，不知道是名字还是某种缩写。

scripts.text: - The building entrance shows distinctive wear and tear, indicating abuse by a steady stream of traffic. YHT and DO NOT YELL are written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 建筑入口有明显磨损，看来平时人来人往。门上写着“YHT”和“DO NOT YELL”（禁止大喊）。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This building is fully furnished, yet there is no sign of habitation.
Maybe the owner lived somewhere else, like in a summer house or something.
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
这栋房子家具齐全，却没有人住过的迹象。
主人也许住在别处，比如度假屋。

scripts.text: - ZERT... is written on the door. The rest of the writing looks like it was scratched off with a stone.-
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“ZERT...”，后面的字似乎被石头刮掉了。 -

scripts.text: - +1 is written on the door. What could it mean? -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“+1”。这是什么意思呢？ -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been a dancer. Her wardrobe is full of glittery stage clothes.
Judging by their size, she must have been very tall for a woman. I wonder how she looked like.
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
这栋房子的主人肯定是舞者，衣柜里全是闪亮的舞台服装。
看尺寸，她对女性来说应该很高。我真想知道她长什么样。

scripts.text: - KDY is written on the door. Sooty streaks that spread outward from the inside to the entrance indicate frequent explosions. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KDY”。从室内延伸到门口的烟熏痕迹，说明这里经常发生爆炸。 -

scripts.text: - KJH is written on the door. The entrance wall is dotted with tiny squares of paper containing time and numbers. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KJH”。入口墙上贴满了写着时间和数字的小纸条。 -

scripts.text: - PKY is written on the door. Empty liquor bottles are littered around the house. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“PKY”。屋子里散落着许多空酒瓶。 -

scripts.text: - DGDG'S BOARD is written on the door. What does that mean? -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“DGDG’S BOARD”。这是什么意思？ -

scripts.text: - THE SUNS is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“THE SUNS”。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
*Cough Cough* The owner of this house was a hoarder.
Lots of books. Lots of cat furballs. Lots of Assassin pictures. *Cough Cough*
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
*咳咳* 这栋房子的主人真是个囤积狂。
好多书，好多猫毛球，还有好多刺客照片。*咳咳*

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This house is full of red mushrooms. Are they edible? Why are they only found inside this house? Was the owner farming them?
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
这屋里长满了红蘑菇。能吃吗？为什么只有这栋屋子里有？主人是在种蘑菇吗？

scripts.text: - MARES is written on the door, along with various drawings that seem to symbolize pirates. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“MARES”，旁边画着各种像是象征海盗的图案。 -

scripts.text: - LMH is written on the door, along with a flurry of hearts drawn on an edge. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“LMH”，门边还画满了爱心。 -

scripts.text: - MISA is written on the door. Various toy weapons are littered around the building. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“MISA”。房子周围散落着各种玩具武器。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
...

[Excavator]
Various pictures are found in this house, all of them featuring the owner with different men.
I find that curious.
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
屋里发现了许多照片，每张都是屋主和不同的男人合影。真奇怪。

scripts.text: - ELTOHC is written on the door. In the center of the door is a W drawn in a circle. It could have been the owner's favorite letter. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“ELTOHC”。门中央画了个圆圈，里面写着W。也许这是屋主最喜欢的字母。 -

scripts.text: - LEONA'S BIRD HEAVEN is written on the door. Unsurprisingly, bird feathers are littered around the house. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“LEONA’S BIRD HEAVEN”。屋子里到处都是鸟羽毛，倒也不奇怪。 -

scripts.text: - KURAT is written on the door. The building wall is littered with hand-drawn skulls. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KURAT”。墙上画满了手绘骷髅。 -

scripts.text: - KSY is written on the door. A poster with The Performance of the Century! boldly printed across it is hung on the entrance wall. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KSY”。入口墙上挂着一张海报，醒目地写着“世纪演出！” -

scripts.text: - BIBIC & MORZIP'S LOVE HOUSE is written on the door. A couple must have lived in this house. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“BIBIC & MORZIP’S LOVE HOUSE”。看来曾有一对情侣住在这里。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been a collector of some sort. There are many pictures of women in strange-looking dresses.
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
这栋房子的主人肯定是个收藏家，屋里有很多穿着奇怪裙子的女性照片。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
Did you see the SKM drawn on the door? That reminds me of the other house with hearts drawn on its door.
I hope it's not one of those childish customs. You know, to mark someone as theirs.
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
你看到门上的“SKM”了吗？这让我想起另一栋门上画满爱心的房子。
希望这不是什么幼稚的标记习俗，比如宣示某人属于自己之类的。

scripts.text: - HDY is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“HDY”。 -

scripts.text: - BRAN is written on the door. Rows of empty bottles are standing on a side of the house. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“BRAN”。房子一侧整齐地排着一列列空瓶。 -

scripts.text: - KYH is written on the door. This building is in better condition than the rest in the neighborhood.-
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KYH”。这栋房子的状况比街区里其他房子好得多。 -

scripts.text: - YAOB is written on the door, along with drawings of round, furry animals. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“YAOB”，旁边画着圆滚滚、毛茸茸的小动物。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This house is suspected to belong to a couple named SSUL and SINYC.
The house is filled with incredible things. Everything in it is just gorgeous.
scripts.translation:
[发掘者]
这栋房子据说属于一对名叫 SSUL 和 SINYC 的伴侣。
里面有好多不可思议的东西，每一件都精美绝伦。

scripts.text: - LMS is written on the door, along with Composition Specialist on an edge. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“LMS”，边缘标着“作曲家”。 -

scripts.text: - KJK is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KJK”。 -

scripts.text: - LJH is written on the door. The building wall is covered with numerous grocery store stickers. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“LJH”。墙上贴满了杂货店的贴纸。 -

scripts.text: - YG is written on the door. A large picture of a smiling baby is visible through a window. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“YG”。透过窗户能看到一张大幅的笑脸婴儿照。 -

scripts.text: - CHJ is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“CHJ”。 -

scripts.text:
[Archaeologist]
Sometimes, we gather around to talk.
Sharing information is a part of the job.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
有时我们会聚在一起聊聊。
交流信息也是工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
What's the hardest thing about my job?
When I'm forced to eat a terrible lunch provided by my sponsor.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
我工作中最难熬的是什么？
就是被迫吃赞助方提供的难吃午餐。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
In fact, it's been that way since I arrived in Verus City.
Today was not an exception.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
自从来到维鲁斯城，我就一直吃这种午餐。
今天也不例外。

scripts.text:
[New Excavator]
I have a lot to learn, and I'm a fast learner.
For now, I'm doing mostly physical tasks.
scripts.translation:
[新发掘者]
我还有很多东西要学，不过学得很快。
目前主要做些体力活。

scripts.text:
[New Excavator]
I'm given free food, a place to sleep, and money. What else can I ask for?
scripts.translation:
[新发掘者]
有免费的饭吃、有地方睡觉，还有钱拿。我还能要求什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Researcher]
I thought this was a part of Juperos.
I'm now reconsidering that theory.
scripts.translation:
[文明研究员]
我原以为这里是朱佩罗斯的一部分。
现在我得重新考虑这个理论了。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Researcher]
Verus is similar to Juperos, yet different.
Everything about it is more refined and sophisticated somehow.
scripts.translation:
[文明研究员]
维鲁斯和朱佩罗斯有相似之处，却又不一样。
这里的一切似乎都更加精致、先进。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
This city's level of mechanical engineering is astonishing.
There's no trace of magic.
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
这座城市的机械工程水平令人惊叹。
看不到任何魔法的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
But I'm concerned:
rapid development and sudden introduction of advanced technology could do more harm than good.
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
不过我有些担心：
发展太快、突然引入先进技术，带来的坏处可能大于好处。

scripts.text:
^FF0000- Caution -
- For your safety, -
- avoid running -
- or jumping -
- while inside. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000- 注意 -
- 为了安全起见， -
- 请勿在室内 -
- 奔跑 -
- 或跳跃。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
Ho ho ho!
I came first, so I took the best spot!
scripts.translation:
[商人]
呵呵呵！
我来得最早，所以占了最好的位置！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer ?]
*Stomach rumbles*
Aww, I'm hungry...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者？]
*肚子咕咕叫*
哎呀，我饿了...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
But I have no money to buy food...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
可我没钱买吃的...

scripts.text:
[Jean Baljean]
Ugh, I was struck 19 times for a piece of bread.
scripts.translation:
[让·巴尔让]
唉，为了一块面包，我挨了19下打。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Mushrooms growing out of rocks.
How resilient!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
蘑菇居然从岩石里长出来了。
生命力真顽强！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Argh!
So many paths are blocked!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
啊！
好多路都被堵住了！

scripts.text:
[Cow]
*Moo*
scripts.translation:
[奶牛]
*哞*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Heh. *Drool*
This place is incredible!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
嘿。*流口水*
这地方真棒！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
This site is amazing.
No wonder why Rekenber called dibs on it.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
这里真了不起。
难怪雷根贝勒抢先把它占下来了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I want to find something awesome!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我想发现点了不起的东西！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
The coming era will be yours.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
未来属于你。

scripts.text:
[Warning]
Attention visitors of Phantasmagorika,
scripts.translation:
[警告]
幻象嘉年华的访客请注意：

scripts.text:
[Warning]
a cult group called the Doom Prayers has been frequently sighted in this area.
scripts.translation:
[警告]
名为“末日祈祷团”的邪教组织近期频繁出现在这一区域。

scripts.text:
[Warning]
If you're a victim or a witness to the group's harassment, please report to the Phantasmagorika Police.
- Phantasmagorika Police Chief -
scripts.translation:
[警告]
如果你是该组织骚扰行为的受害者或目击者，请向幻象嘉年华警察队报告。
- 幻象嘉年华警察队长 -

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
I must investi... ga... te...
Zzz... Zzz...

[Adventurer Cat]
*Purr*
*Meow*
scripts.translation:
[冒险猫]
*呼噜*
*喵*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
For some reason, I can't stand up.
*Meow*
scripts.translation:
[冒险猫]
不知道为什么，我站不起来。
*喵*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
I've got a good spot.
*Purr*
scripts.translation:
[冒险猫]
我找到好位置了。
*呼噜*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Ah!
I want to see!
Why can't I go in?!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
啊！
我想进去看看！
为什么不让我进去？！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
All right!
This time, I'm going to write a report on a field trip to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
好吧！
这次我要写一篇幻象嘉年华实地考察报告。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Professor Jones will be so impressed he'll give me A+. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
琼斯教授肯定会很满意，给我A+。*轻笑*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Toh!
Sound mind, sound body!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
嘿！
健全的精神寓于健康的身体！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I'd better pack enough potions for the trip to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
去幻象嘉年华之前，最好多带些药水。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I'm impressed by Rekenber's support.
Um...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
雷根贝勒真是支持我们啊。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
Ooooh!
I've found a perfect spot for my business!
scripts.translation:
[商人]
哦哦！
我找到做生意的绝佳地点了！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Elevator? The scientific advancement of Schwarzwald is astonishing!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
电梯？修瓦尔兹巴尔德的科技真先进！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
An ancient civilization. Doesn't that sound incredible?
I feel like I can hear ancient machines moving with loud clanking noises.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
古代文明，听起来多不可思议！
我仿佛都听见古老机器轰隆作响。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
*Dreamy eyes*
*Gaping mouth*
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
*眼神迷离*
*张大嘴巴*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Geez, this place is already crammed!
Just looking at these people makes me tired.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
天哪，这里已经挤爆了！
光看着这些人我就觉得累。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
It was working fine just a moment ago.
I'm sorry.
I'll have to call in a technician. Please use the stairs instead.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
刚才还好好的。
真抱歉，我得叫技术人员来修。请先走楼梯吧。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
^0000FFPhantasmagorika is past the tunnel to the south from the southeast gate outside Juperos Ruins.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
^0000FF幻象嘉年华位于朱佩罗斯遗迹东南门外隧道的南侧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
There are elevator doors near the fountain in the center of the place. Could you check what happened to the elevator?
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
这里中央的喷泉附近有电梯门。能帮我看看电梯出了什么问题吗？

scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text: - Someone died! -
scripts.translation: - 有人受伤了！ -

scripts.text: - Unfortunately, the person who died stuck in the elevator door, and the elevator that opened and closed constantly stuck to him.. -
scripts.translation: - 不幸的是，那个人卡在电梯门里，被不断开合的电梯夹住了... -

[{0}]
你还好吗？

......

...

...别管我...

What?

I am fine, let me go..
scripts.translation:

我没事，让我走...

But you don't look like it's nothing...
Wait here,
I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你看起来伤得不轻...
在这里等着，
我来帮你。

scripts.text:

Just telling you that I dont... Hey! My waist!!!
scripts.translation:
[倒地男子]
我只是想说我没...喂！我的腰！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will help you find a doctor!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我去帮你找医生！

scripts.text:

Excuse me, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[倒地男子]
麻烦你了，谢谢。

scripts.text: later, the boys lying on the stretcher were embarrassed and suddenly grabbed my hand..

scripts.translation: 后来，担架上的男孩显得有些腼腆，突然把一个小水果塞到我手里...

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Weird!! How can the elevator suddenly move again?
maybe the following people have something to do?
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
真奇怪！！电梯怎么突然又能动了？
难道和下面那几个人有关？

scripts.translation:

古代遗迹新发现：幻象嘉年华！
联系^0000FF乐园团^000000，加入幻象嘉年华发掘项目！

您好。
请告诉我您的名字，我来确认登记信息。

嗯，我查查看...
抱歉，名单上没有你。能确认一下登记状态吗？

scripts.text:

You're back already.
scripts.translation:

你这么快就回来了。

scripts.translation:

抱歉。
电梯现在故障，暂时不能用。

scripts.text:

God! How come again!!!
This bad elevator is always broken! Everyday!!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
天啊！怎么又坏了！！！
这破电梯老是出故障！天天都坏！！！

我看看...

现在要^0000FF前往幻象嘉年华^000000吗？

Have a good day.

祝你今天愉快。

Ready?
Have a safe exploration!
scripts.translation:

准备好了吗？
祝你探索顺利！

[Mark]
By the gods, Du!
You're going to give me a heart attack!
scripts.translation:
[马克]
天哪，杜！
你要吓死我了！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
What about the fountain?
scripts.translation:
[马克]
那喷泉呢？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Whew! {0}, you've saved us.
Sigh, I don't know when he's going to grow up.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
呼！{0}，你救了我们。
唉，真不知道他什么时候才能长大。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
An excavation project of this scale should attract throngs of people.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
如此规模的发掘项目，应该会吸引大批人群。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I told you stop jumping!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
我告诉过你停止跳！

scripts.text:
[Du]
WAAAAAHH-!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哇啊啊啊——！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
What did you do in the elevator?
I told you not to run or jump inside the elevator!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽]
你在电梯里干什么？
我说过不要在电梯里跑或跳的！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Argh,
nothing is going in my favor!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
真是的，
怎么什么都不顺利！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Hm, did Du find something in the fountain?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
嗯，杜在喷泉里发现什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Thank you.
Sigh, I don't want to imagine what might have happened if you, {0}, didn't pass by at that moment.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
谢谢你。
唉，我不敢想象如果那一刻没有你，{0}，会发生什么事。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Look, I wiped it, and it sparkles!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
看，我擦干净了，它在闪闪发光！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Why can't you just listen to us?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
你为什么就不能听我们说话呢？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Stop wasting your time on something so stupid!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
别在这种无聊的事情上浪费时间了！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Um...
Wait.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
嗯...
等等。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Look, it doesn't look like it's been buried deep underground for centuries.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
你看，它看起来并不像是在地下埋藏了几个世纪的样子。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
You're right. It looks too clean underneath all the dirt and grime.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
你说得对。在那些污垢之下，它看起来太干净了。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Um...
It's too clean. I can't tell anything about it.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
嗯...
太干净了。我看不出任何线索。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
If this fountain was ever used, it should have some sort of deposit left on the bottom, but there's none at all. It's almost as if the water was drained out of it at once.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
如果这个喷泉曾经被使用过，底部应该会有某种沉积物，但这里一点都没有。就好像水被一次性排干了一样。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
The deposit could have been wiped off naturally after a long time.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
沉积物可能在漫长的时间里自然消失了。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Let's look around for something else.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
我们找找别的东西吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
How about those sundries on the left side?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
左边的那些杂物怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Let's look around for something else.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
我们找找别的东西吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
How about those sundries on the left side?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
左边的那些杂物怎么样？

scripts.text:
- Ordinary-looking Fountain -
- There's nothing in it. -
scripts.translation:
- 看起来普普通通的喷泉 -
- 里面什么都没有。 -

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Hm...
Everything looks too clean.
This site doesn't look like it's as old as we thought it was.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
嗯...
一切都太干净了。
这个遗址看起来不像我们以为的那么古老。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Aside from those piles of broken machines, nothing looks too special.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
除了那些破碎的机器堆，没有什么特别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
And look at the tree on the left side.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
还有左边的那棵树。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Look at the tree on the left side.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
看看左边的那棵树。

scripts.text: - The ground is littered with sundries. -
scripts.translation: - 地上散落着各种杂物。 -

scripts.text:
[Du]
I've been wondering since we arrived: don't trees need sunlight to grow?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
我进来后就一直在想：树不是需要阳光才能生长吗？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
*Gasp*
Du, that's the smartest thing I've ever heard you say.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
*倒吸一口凉气*
杜，这是你说过最聪明的一句话。

scripts.text:
[Du]
What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
你说什么？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
How did this tree grow underground?
There's no sunlight.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
这棵树是怎么在地下长出来的？
这里没有阳光啊。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
It doesn't look like it's enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
看起来并没有被施加魔法。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Oh, look here!
Something strange is standing in front of the door!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哦，看这里！
门前站着个奇怪的东西！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Oh, look here!
Something strange is standing in front of the door!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哦，看这里！
门前站着个奇怪的东西！

scripts.text:
A tall, verdant tree.
Nothing looks special about it, except that it's growing underground.
scripts.translation:
一棵高大茂盛的树。
除了它生长在地下之外，看起来没什么特别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hey!
Stop wandering off! This place can be dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[马克]
嘿！
别到处乱跑！这地方很危险！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Adventuring is all about bravery and curiosity!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
冒险就是勇气和好奇心！

scripts.text:
[Du]
And I'm not going to let other people take all the treasures!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
而且我才不会让别人抢走所有的宝物！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Last time you said that, you were hospitalized for a month.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
上次你这么说，结果在医院躺了一个月。

scripts.text:
[Du]
This time, it's different!
Plus, what doesn't kill me only makes me stronger. It did!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
这次不一样！
再说了，杀不死我的只会让我更强。上次就是这样！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
You're delusional.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
你真是异想天开。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Oh,
wait.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
哦，
等等。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Look behind the building.
There's a path that leads upward.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
看建筑物后面。
有一条向上的路。

scripts.text:
[Du]
I go
wherever my instinct leads me!
Mwah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
我要去哪里，
全凭我的直觉！
哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Du, stop!
Did you not hear me?!
scripts.translation:
[马克]
杜，站住！
你没听到我说话吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Grr!
He's out of control.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
可恶！
他完全失控了。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Mark,
Du's managed to get that far already.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
马克，
杜已经跑到那么远了。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Grr!
That knucklehead!
scripts.translation:
[马克]
可恶！
那个笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
We'd better follow him before we lose him.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我们最好赶紧跟上他，别让他跑丢了。

scripts.text:

有一条向上的路。

杜已经跑到那么远了。

That knucklehead!

可恶！
那个笨蛋！

scripts.text:

We'd better follow him before we lose him.
scripts.translation:

我们最好赶紧跟上他，别让他跑丢了。

scripts.text: - The door is blocked. -
scripts.translation: - 门被堵住了。-

scripts.text:
[Du]
Whoa...
I thought this place would be the same as the last one, but it's overrun with machines.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哇...
我以为这里会和上一个地方一样，结果到处都是机器。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Are these the same as those in Juperos?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
这些和朱佩罗斯的那些是一样的吗？

scripts.text:
[Du]
What does this place have to do with Juperos?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
这个地方和朱佩罗斯有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Up there, I saw another fountain looking similar to the last one.
Do you want to go check it out?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
上面那里，我看到另一个喷泉，看起来和上一个很像。
你要去看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Up there, I saw another fountain looking similar to the last one.
Do you want to go check it out?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
上面那里，我看到另一个喷泉，看起来和上一个很像。
你要去看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Du]
What does this place have to do with Juperos?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
这个地方和朱佩罗斯有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Hm...
This place is disturbingly clean.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
嗯...
这里干净得让人不安。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
All the buildings are well preserved. What do you think happened to the owners?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
所有的建筑都保存得很完好。你觉得主人去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
If they're dead, they're not buried or left to rot in here. If they left... well, I don't think they did.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
如果他们死了，这里没有尸体，也没有腐烂的痕迹。如果他们离开了...我不觉得他们离开了。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
I tried to read with magic,
but to no avail.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
我试着用魔法读取信息，
但没有任何反应。

scripts.text:
[Du]
So the trail of clues went cold.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
看来线索断了。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Ouch! Why did you hit me?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哎哟！你干嘛打我？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I'll take the path north. Meet me up there later.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我去北边的路。稍后在上面碰头。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Keep an eye on Du; he wanders off easily.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
看好杜，他很容易走丢。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I'll take the path north. Meet me up there later.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我去北边的路。稍后在上面碰头。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Keep an eye on Du; he wanders off easily.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
看好杜，他很容易走丢。

scripts.text:
- Ordinary-looking Fountain -
- There's nothing in it. -
scripts.translation:
- 看起来普普通通的喷泉 -
- 里面什么都没有。 -

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Do you see the giant machine ahead of us?
Unlike the first place, this place is filled with giant machines.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
你看到前面的巨型机器了吗？
和第一个地方不同，这里到处都是巨型机器。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Buildings are crumbled. The ground is caved in here and there.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
建筑已经坍塌，地面这里那里都塌陷了。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I've found a path over there, though it's blocked.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我在那边发现了一条路，不过被堵住了。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
That doesn't bode well.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
这可不是好兆头。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Oh, Tamarin!
Don't go over there!
scripts.translation:
[马克]
哦，塔马林！
别去那边！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Oh, Tamarin!
Don't go over there!
scripts.translation:
[马克]
哦，塔马林！
别去那边！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Do you see the giant machine ahead of us?
Unlike the first place, this place is filled with giant machines.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
你看到前面的巨型机器了吗？
和第一个地方不同，这里到处都是巨型机器。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Look over there.
That part of the place is completely destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
看那边。
那部分地方完全被摧毁了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Maggi, how's it like over there?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
玛姬，那边情况怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Oh.
The path over here is also blocked.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
哦。
这边的路也被堵住了。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
I'm sensing some kind of current on the other side,
but I can't tell exactly what.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
我感觉到那边有一股气流，
但具体是什么还说不清楚。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
It doesn't feel like a living thing,
but it's strong just the same.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
感觉不像是有生命的东西，
但力量依然很强。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Um.
I really don't want to go over there.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
嗯。
我真的不想去那边。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...!
That's a first. You earned the nickname Red-haired Boar because you never stop running.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
...!
真是头一回。你得了“红发野猪”这个绰号，就是因为从来没停过脚步。

scripts.text:
[Du]
No one calls me that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
没人这么叫我！

scripts.text:
[Du]
I've got cooler nicknames! Call me those!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
我有更酷的绰号！叫那个！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Du.
Don't insult boars.
All their parts, from head to toe, are useful.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
杜。
别侮辱野猪。
它们从头到脚，每一部分都有用。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Delicious, too.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
而且很好吃。

scripts.text:
[Du]
That's not the point!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
重点不是这个！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Du's instinct has never betrayed us. We should steer clear of that path.
Right, Boar?
scripts.translation:
[马克]
杜的直觉从来没让我们失望过。我们应该避开那条路。
对吧，野猪？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Grr!
I said
don't call me that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哼！
我说了
别这么叫我！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
The path is blocked, and if the Phantasmagorika Excavation Team hasn't cleared it, then there must be a reason. Let's steer clear of it until we find out more about it.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
路被堵住了，如果幻影挖掘队没有清理它，那肯定有原因。在弄清楚更多情况之前，让我们避开它吧。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Don't you make fun of me!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
别取笑我！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I agree.
Let's check the other places first.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我同意。
让我们先检查其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
The path is blocked, and if the Phantasmagorika Excavation Team hasn't cleared it, then there must be a reason. Let's steer clear of it until we find out more about it.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
路被堵住了，如果幻影挖掘队没有清理它，那肯定有原因。在弄清楚更多情况之前，让我们避开它吧。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I agree.
Let's check the other places first.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我同意。
让我们先检查其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Danger is in the air. I can feel it in my bones.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
危险的气息在空气中弥漫。我能从骨子里感觉到。

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
So, um... I'm...
I think I'm sent here
to... to... Let me think...
Oh yes, to support the Morroc restoration work.
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
所以，嗯... 我是...
我想我是被派到这里来... 来... 让我想想...
哦对了，是为了支持梦罗克的修复工作。

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
The restoration work is finished,
but I remain
to finish rewarding the volunteers.
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
修复工作已经完成了，
但我留下来是为了完成对志愿者的奖励发放。

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
So, how may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
那么，今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Claim rewards.
scripts.translation: 领取奖励

scripts.text: What can I do with the Contribution Certificate Vending Machine?
scripts.translation: 贡献证明贩卖机有什么用？

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
In recognition of your credit,
we will grant you a certificate.
The certificates can be used by the vending machine next to it.
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
为了表彰您的贡献，
我们将颁发给您证书。
您可以在旁边的贩卖机上使用这些证书。

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
You haven't finished your quest,
or never accepted one. Please check your quest history.
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
您尚未完成任务，或者从未接受过任务。请检查您的任务记录。

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
Do you see the vending machine next to me?
You can use your Certificates with the machine
to get EXP and a variety of items in exchange.
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
您看到我旁边的贩卖机了吗？
您可以使用证书在机器上兑换经验值和多种物品。

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
For more details, you should click the vending machine.
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
如需了解更多详情，请点击贩卖机。

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
Um, so...
Why did you
talk to me, if I may ask?
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
嗯，那个...
请问您找我有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Reward Coordinator]
Aww, I hate this sandy wind.
It leaves my nice clothes
sandy and nasty-feeling.
scripts.translation:
[奖励协调员]
哎呀，我讨厌这沙风。
它让我漂亮的衣服沾满沙子，感觉很不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Morroc Restoration Project Director Paek]
Currently the greatest contributor is
Great Adventurer {0},
who has made a total of {1} contributions so far.
I'd like to give thanks to this adventurer on behalf of the entire city.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克重建计划主管 白]
